1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_irq.c
3:  *
4:  * D13x 中断系统适配（CLIC 中断控制器）
5:  * CLIC 寄存器来源: luban-lite core_rv32.h CLIC_Type 结构体
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
15: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
16: #include "chip.h"
17: 
18: /****************************************************************************
19:  * Pre-processor Definitions
20:  ****************************************************************************/
21: 
22: /* CLIC 寄存器结构 (来源: luban-lite core_rv32.h CLIC_Type)
23:  *
24:  * CLIC 基地址: 0x20800000
25:  * 每个中断源占 4 字节: IP(1B), IE(1B), ATTR(1B), CTL(1B)
26:  * CLICINT[] 数组起始偏移: 0x1000
27:  *
28:  * struct CLIC_Type {
29:  *   uint32_t CLICCFG;      // offset 0x000
30:  *   uint32_t CLICINFO;     // offset 0x004
31:  *   uint32_t MINTTHRESH;   // offset 0x008
32:  *   uint32_t RESERVED[1021];
33:  *   CLIC_INT_Control CLICINT[4096];  // offset 0x1000
34:  * };
35:  *
36:  * struct CLIC_INT_Control {
37:  *   uint8_t IP;    // offset +0x000 (pending)
38:  *   uint8_t IE;    // offset +0x001 (enable)
39:  *   uint8_t ATTR;  // offset +0x002 (attribute: vector/shv)
40:  *   uint8_t CTL;   // offset +0x003 (control: priority)
41:  * };
42:  */
43: 
44: #define D13X_CLIC_BASE         D13X_E907_CLIC_BASE   /* 0x20800000 */
45: #define D13X_CLIC_CFG          (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0000)
46: #define D13X_CLIC_INFO         (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0004)
47: #define D13X_CLIC_MINTTHRESH   (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0008)
48: #define D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE     (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x1000)  /* CLICINT[] 起始 */
49: 
50: /* 中断向量表地址（RISC-V 使用 __trap_vec） */
51: 
52: extern uint32_t __trap_vec[];
53: 
54: /****************************************************************************
55:  * Private Functions
56:  ****************************************************************************/
57: 
58: /****************************************************************************
59:  * Name: d13x_clic_set_irq
60:  *
61:  * Description:
62:  *   设置指定中断的 IE/IP/ATTR 寄存器
63:  *
64:  ****************************************************************************/
65: 
66: static inline void d13x_clic_enable_irq(int irq)
67: {
68:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 1 */
69: 
70:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
71:   *ie = 1;
72: }
73: 
74: static inline void d13x_clic_disable_irq(int irq)
75: {
76:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 0 */
77: 
78:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
79:   *ie = 0;
80: }
81: 
82: static inline void d13x_clic_clear_pending(int irq)
83: {
84:   /* CLICINT[irq].IP = 0 (W1C) */
85: 
86:   volatile uint8_t *ip = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 0);
87:   *ip = 0;
88: }
89: 
90: static inline void d13x_clic_set_attr(int irq, uint8_t attr)
91: {
92:   /* CLICINT[irq].ATTR = attr */
93: 
94:   volatile uint8_t *attrp = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 2);
95:   *attrp = attr;
96: }
97: 
98: /****************************************************************************
99:  * Public Functions
100:  ****************************************************************************/
101: 
102: /****************************************************************************
103:  * Name: up_irqinitialize
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Initialize the interrupt subsystem
107:  *
108:  ****************************************************************************/
109: 
110: void up_irqinitialize(void)
111: {
112:   int i;
113: 
114:   /* 配置 mtvec (mode 3) + mtvt 双 CSR */
115: 
116:   uint32_t mtvec = (uint32_t)__trap_vec | 0x3;
117:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw mtvec, %0" :: "r"(mtvec));
118: 
119:   /* mtvt CSR (T-Head 扩展，CSR 编号 0x7C0) */
120: 
121:   uint32_t mtvt = (uint32_t)__trap_vec;
122:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw 0x7C0, %0" :: "r"(mtvt));
123: 
124:   /* 初始化 CLIC 中断控制器 (来源: luban-lite system.c SystemInit) */
125: 
126:   /* 读取 CLIC 配置信息 */
127: 
128:   volatile uint32_t *cliccfg = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_CFG;
129:   volatile uint32_t *clicinfo = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_INFO;
130: 
131:   uint32_t info = *clicinfo;
132:   uint32_t nlbits = (info >> 21) & 0xF;
133: 
134:   *cliccfg = (nlbits << 1) & 0x1E;
135: 
136:   /* 初始化所有中断: 清除 pending, 使能向量中断 */
137: 
138:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_IRQn; i++)
139:     {
140:       d13x_clic_clear_pending(i);
141:       d13x_clic_set_attr(i, 1);  /* use vector interrupt */
142:     }
143: 
144:   /* tspend 使用正向中断 (来源: luban-lite system.c) */
145: 
146:   d13x_clic_set_attr(Machine_Software_IRQn, 0x3);
147: 
148:   /* 使能全局中断 */
149: 
150:   up_irq_enable();
151: }
152: 
153: /****************************************************************************
154:  * Name: up_enable_irq
155:  *
156:  * Description:
157:  *   Enable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
158:  *
159:  ****************************************************************************/
160: 
161: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
162: {
163:   d13x_clic_enable_irq(irq);
164: }
165: 
166: /****************************************************************************
167:  * Name: up_disable_irq
168:  *
169:  * Description:
170:  *   Disable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
171:  *
172:  ****************************************************************************/
173: 
174: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
175: {
176:   d13x_clic_disable_irq(irq);
177: }
178: 
179: /****************************************************************************
180:  * Name: riscv_dispatch_irq
181:  *
182:  * Description:
183:  *   Process interrupt and dispatch to registered handler
184:  *
185:  ****************************************************************************/
186: 
187: void *riscv_dispatch_irq(uint32_t mcause, uint32_t *regs)
188: {
189:   int irq;
190: 
191:   /* 读取中断号 */
192: 
193:   irq = (int)(mcause & 0x7FFFFFFF);
194: 
195:   /* 调用中断处理函数 */
196: 
197:   irq_dispatch(irq, regs);
198: 
199:   return regs;
200: }
201: 
202: /****************************************************************************
203:  * Name: up_irq_enable
204:  *
205:  * Description:
206:  *   Enable all interrupts
207:  *
208:  ****************************************************************************/
209: 
210: irqstate_t up_irq_enable(void)
211: {
212:   irqstate_t flags;
213: 
214:   /* 读取当前中断状态 */
215: 
216:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, mstatus" : "=r"(flags));
217: 
218:   /* 使能中断 */
219: 
220:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrsi mstatus, 0x8");
221: 
222:   return flags;
223: }

35: /* GTC_CNTCR 位定义 */
36: 
37: #define GTC_CNTCR_EN             (1 << 0)   /* 计数器使能 */
38: #define GTC_CNTCR_HDBG           (1 << 1)   /* 调试时保持 */
39: 
40: /* GTC 中断号: GTC 通过 CLIC 直接产生中断，IRQ 号取决于硬件连线
41:  * luban-lite 使用 CORET (IRQ 7) 作为系统 tick，GTC 仅用于使能计数
42:  * NuttX arch_alarm 模型需要一个 IRQ，使用 CORET_IRQn (7) 或
43:  * 通过 oneshot 软件比较实现。此处使用 CORET_IRQn 作为中断源。
44:  */
45: 
46: #define D13X_IRQ_GTC             7   /* CORET_IRQn, 与 luban-lite 一致 */
47: 
48: /* GTC 时钟频率: 基频 4MHz (D13x User Manual §11.1.1)
49:  * PCLK 可选 12/24/48/60 MHz，GTC 内部分频到 4MHz 基频
50:  * luban-lite system.c 中: *(volatile uint32_t *)GTC_BASE = 0x0001 (使能)
51:  * 计数频率由 GTC_CONFG 的 FDIV 字段控制
52:  */
53: 
54: #define GTC_BASE_FREQ            4000000    /* 4MHz 基频 */
55: 
56: /****************************************************************************
57:  * Private Types
58:  ****************************************************************************/
59: 
60: struct d13x_oneshot_lowerhalf_s
61: {
62:   struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s lower;
63: };
64: 
65: /****************************************************************************
66:  * Private Data
67:  ****************************************************************************/
68: 
69: static struct d13x_oneshot_lowerhalf_s g_d13x_oneshot;
70: 
71: /****************************************************************************
72:  * Private Functions
73:  ****************************************************************************/
74: 
75: /****************************************************************************
76:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_current
77:  *
78:  * Description:
79:  *   Get the current timer value (clkcnt_t API)
80:  *
81:  ****************************************************************************/
82: 
83: static clkcnt_t d13x_oneshot_current(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
84: {
85:   /* 读取 64-bit 计数值: 先读高 32 位，再读低 32 位，再读高 32 位
86:    * 如果高 32 位变化了，说明发生了进位，需要重读
87:    */
88: 
89:   uint32_t high1, low, high2;
90: 
91:   do
92:     {
93:       high1 = getreg32(GTC_CNTVH);
94:       low   = getreg32(GTC_CNTVL);
95:       high2 = getreg32(GTC_CNTVH);
96:     }
97:   while (high1 != high2);
98: 
99:   return (clkcnt_t)(((uint64_t)high1 << 32) | low);
100: }
101: 
102: /****************************************************************************
103:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_start
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Start the oneshot timer with a relative delay (clkcnt_t API)
107:  *
108:  ****************************************************************************/
109: 
110: static void d13x_oneshot_start(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
111:                                clkcnt_t delay)
112: {
113:   uint32_t now_lo = getreg32(GTC_CNTVL);
114:   uint32_t cmp = now_lo + (uint32_t)delay;
115: 
116:   putreg32(cmp, GTC_CNTVL);  /* 写入比较值到低 32 位 */
117: }
118: 
119: /****************************************************************************
120:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_start_absolute
121:  *
122:  * Description:
123:  *   Start the oneshot timer with an absolute counter value (clkcnt_t API)
124:  *
125:  ****************************************************************************/
126: 
127: static void d13x_oneshot_start_absolute(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
128:                                         clkcnt_t cnt)
129: {
130:   putreg32((uint32_t)cnt, GTC_CNTVL);
131: }
132: 
133: /****************************************************************************
134:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_cancel
135:  *
136:  * Description:
137:  *   Cancel the oneshot timer (clkcnt_t API)
138:  *
139:  ****************************************************************************/
140: 
141: static void d13x_oneshot_cancel(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
142: {
143:   /* 清除比较匹配: 写入一个不会匹配的值 */
144:   putreg32(0xFFFFFFFF, GTC_CNTVL);
145: }
146: 
147: /****************************************************************************
148:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_maxdelay
149:  *
150:  * Description:
151:  *   Get the maximum delay value (clkcnt_t API)
152:  *
153:  ****************************************************************************/
154: 
155: static clkcnt_t d13x_oneshot_maxdelay(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
156: {
157:   return (clkcnt_t)0xFFFFFFFF;
158: }
159: 
160: /****************************************************************************
161:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_handler
162:  *
163:  * Description:
164:  *   Timer interrupt handler (CORET_IRQn)
165:  *
166:  ****************************************************************************/
167: 
168: static int d13x_oneshot_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
169: {
170:   struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower = arg;
171: 
172:   /* 调用上层回调 */
173: 
174:   if (lower->callback)
175:     {
176:       lower->callback(lower, lower->arg);
177:     }
178: 
179:   return OK;
180: }
181: 
182: /****************************************************************************
183:  * Private Data
184:  ****************************************************************************/
185: 
186: static const struct oneshot_operations_s g_d13x_oneshot_ops =
187: {
188:   .current        = d13x_oneshot_current,
189:   .start          = d13x_oneshot_start,
190:   .start_absolute = d13x_oneshot_start_absolute,
191:   .cancel         = d13x_oneshot_cancel,
192:   .max_delay      = d13x_oneshot_maxdelay,
193: };
194: 
195: /****************************************************************************
196:  * Public Functions
197:  ****************************************************************************/
198: 
199: /****************************************************************************
200:  * Name: up_timer_initialize
201:  *
202:  * Description:
203:  *   This function is called during start-up to initialize the timer
204:  *   interrupt.
205:  *
206:  ****************************************************************************/
207: 
208: void up_timer_initialize(void)
209: {
210:   /* 使能 GTC 计数器 (来源: luban-lite system.c aic_gtc_enable) */
211: 
212:   putreg32(GTC_CNTCR_EN, GTC_CNTCR);
213: 
214:   /* 绑定中断处理函数 (使用 CORET_IRQn, 与 luban-lite 一致) */
215: 
216:   irq_attach(D13X_IRQ_GTC, d13x_oneshot_handler, &g_d13x_oneshot.lower);
217:   up_enable_irq(D13X_IRQ_GTC);
218: 
219:   /* 初始化 oneshot 计数器，使用 4MHz 基频 */
220: 
221:   oneshot_count_init(&g_d13x_oneshot.lower, GTC_BASE_FREQ);
222: 
223:   /* 创建 oneshot 实例并绑定系统定时器 */
224: 
225:   g_d13x_oneshot.lower.ops = &g_d13x_oneshot_ops;
226:   up_alarm_set_lowerhalf(&g_d13x_oneshot.lower);
227: }

1: D13x 芯片全参数、信息与方案文档
2: 芯片厂商：广东匠芯创科技有限公司（ArtInChip）
3: 芯片系列：D13x
4: 内核架构：RISC-V（平头哥玄铁 E907）
5: 文档版本：v1.0
6: 更新日期：2026-06-13
7: 
8: === 芯片总览 ===
9: D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。
10: 
11: 核心特性：
12: - CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
13: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
14: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
15: - Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
16: - 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
17: - 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
18: - 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
19: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
20: - 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC
21: - USB: 1×USB 2.0 HS-USB
22: - 串口: 8×UART
23: - SPI: 4×SPI
24: - I2C: 3×I2C
25: - CAN: 2×CAN 2.0B
26: - PWM: 8 路 PWM + 24 路 EPWM + 6 路 CAP
27: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12 通道）
28: - 封装: QFN68 / QFN88 / QFN100
29: 
30: === 本次大赛使用型号 ===
31: D133EBS（衡山派开发板），QFN100 封装，1MB SRAM + 8MB PSRAM
32: 
33: === CPU 内核参数 ===
34: 架构: RISC-V
35: 指令集: RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]
36: 位宽: 32 位
37: 主频: 480MHz @ 1.1V
38: 流水线: 5 级按序流水线
39: 浮点单元: 可选单精度 F / 双精度 D
40: 中断控制器: CLIC（Core Local Interrupt Controller）
41: 
42: E907 与标准 RISC-V 差异：
43: - 向量表 CSR: mtvec（mode 3）+ mtvt 双 CSR
44: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
45: - TCM: ITCM + DTCM
46: - 栈保护: mscratch + SPSWAPEN 扩展
47: - FPU 控制: MXSTATUS 扩展
48: - Cache 控制: T-Head 扩展的 icache_enable/dcache_enable
49: 
50: === 存储系统 ===
51: 片上存储:
52: - BROM: 64KB（Boot ROM，出厂固化）
53: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB
54: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封，16 位控制器）
55: - ITCM: 可配置，地址 0x30040000
56: - DTCM: 可配置，地址 0x30060000
57: 
58: 外部存储接口:
59: - QSPI: 2 套
60: - eMMC: eMMC 4.5
61: - SD/SDIO: SD 3.01 / SDIO 3.0
62: 
63: 启动方式: SD Card → SPI NOR → SPI NAND → eMMC
64: 
65: === 内存地址映射 ===
66: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
67: SRAM: 0x20000000
68: PSRAM: 0x30000000
69: ITCM: 0x30040000
70: DTCM: 0x30060000
71: 外设区域: 0x18000000~
72: 
73: 外设基地址:
74: - CMU: 0x18020000
75: - GPIO: 0x18700000
76: - UART0: 0x18710000
77: 
78: === 时钟系统（CMU）===
79: 时钟源: OSC24M（内部振荡器）24MHz
80: 
81: PLL 配置:
82: - PLL_INT0: 480MHz（CPU 时钟）
83: - PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz（总线/模块时钟源）
84: 
85: 模块时钟:
86: - CPU: PLL_INT0 = 480MHz
87: - AXI/AHB: PLL_INT1 ÷6 = 200MHz
88: - APB0: PLL_INT1 ÷12 = 100MHz
89: - UART0: PLL_INT1 ÷20 = 60MHz
90: 
91: CMU 初始化流程:
92: 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 (PLL_IN = 0x180200A4, bit1=1)
93: 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO (PLL_COM = 0x180200A0)
94: 3. 配置 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49)
95: 4. 配置 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19)
96: 5. 总线时钟: AXI/AHB=200M, APB0=100M
97: 6. CPU 时钟: 480MHz
98: 7. 打开 GPIO 时钟
99: 8. 打开 UART0 时钟 (60MHz)
100: 
101: === UART 详情 ===
102: 基地址: 0x18710000
103: 模块时钟: 60MHz
104: 波特率: 115200 8N1
105: divisor = 60M / (16 × 115200) ≈ 33
106: 控制器类型: 16550 兼容
107: IRQ: 76
108: 调试串口引脚: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX)，PIN_FUN = 5
109: 
110: 16550 寄存器偏移:
111: - RBR/THR: 0x00
112: - DLL: 0x00
113: - DLH: 0x04
114: - FCR: 0x08
115: - LCR: 0x0C
116: - MCR: 0x10
117: - LSR: 0x14
118: - MSR: 0x18
119: 
120: === GPIO 详情 ===
121: 基地址: 0x18700000
122: 时钟: APB0 总线时钟, CLK_GPIO @ 0x1802083C
123: 
124: === 启动流程 ===
125: 1. BROM (64KB) 扫描启动源
126: 2. SPL/Bootloader 初始化 DDR/PSRAM
127: 3. startup_gcc.S (Reset_Handler):
128:    - save_boot_params
129:    - 初始化 gp
130:    - 设置 mtvec = Default_Handler | 3 (mode 3)
131:    - 设置 mtvt = __Vectors
132:    - 设置 sp = g_top_irqstack
133:    - 使能 ICache/DCache
134:    - 使能 TCM (ITCM + DTCM)
135:    - 配置 SRAM1
136:    - 配置 PSRAM 属性
137:    - 清零 BSS
138:    - SystemInit()
139:    - 跳转 entry()/main()
140: 4. SystemInit(): FPU, Cache, CLIC, tick
141: 5. aic_clk_init(): 时钟初始化
142: 6. board_uart_init(): 引脚复用
143: 7. uart_init(): 16550 初始化
144: 8. 系统就绪
145: 
146: === 向量表结构 ===
147: 表长度: 100 项 × 4 字节
148: 位置: .data 段（可写 RAM）
149: 通过 mtvt CSR 绑定
150: 
151: === 开发板：衡山派 D133EBS ===
152: - 主控: D133EBS，QFN100 封装
153: - SRAM: 1MB, PSRAM: 8MB
154: - NOR FLASH: 16MB
155: - USB: 1×USB2.0（Type-C，支持烧录调试）
156: - 调试: 1×JTAG
157: - 串口: 1×UART0（115200 8N1）
158: - TF-Card: 1×TF-Card 接口
159: - 显示: LVDS + RGB 接口、电容式触摸屏接口
160: - 屏幕: 4.3 寸电容触摸屏（预装）
161: - 摄像头: 1×DVP 摄像头接口
162: - 以太网: 1×RMII 百兆以太网
163: - WiFi: 1×SDIO WIFI
164: - 电源: 5V Type-C 或 5~12V 直流
165: 
166: === SDK ===
167: Luban-Lite (RT-Thread): https://gitee.com/artinchip/luban-lite
168: 关键源文件:
169: - startup_gcc.S: 启动汇编
170: - vectors.S: 默认异常处理
171: - system.c: SystemInit()
172: - aic_clk.c: 时钟初始化
173: - aic_soc.h: 基址、寄存器偏移
174: - aic_pinmux.c: 引脚复用
175: - aic_dw_uart.c: 16550 UART 驱动
176: - aic_drv_irq.c: 中断驱动
177: - gcc_aic.ld: 链接脚本
178: 
179: 工具链: RISC-V GCC (xPack 或 SiFive)
180: 烧录: AiBurn / AiBurnPro
181: 调试: OpenOCD + GDB
182: 
183: === openvela 适配方案 ===
184: 需要创建的文件:
185: 
186: 芯片层 (chips/d13x/):
187: - chip.h, include/chip.h, include/irq.h
188: - Kconfig, Make.defs
189: - artinchip_start.c (__start 入口)
190: - artinchip_irq.c (中断适配)
191: - artinchip_lowputc.c (低级串口)
192: - artinchip_uart.c (完整串口驱动)
193: - artinchip_oneshot.c (定时器驱动)
194: - artinchip_allocateheap.c (堆内存初始化)
195: 
196: 板级层 (boards/d13x/hengshan-pi/):
197: - configs/nsh/defconfig
198: - include/board.h
199: - scripts/ld.script
200: - scripts/Make.defs
201: - src/artinchip_boot.c
202: - src/artinchip_bringup.c
203: - src/artinchip_appinit.c
204: 
205: 关键实现要点:
206: 1. 时钟初始化: CMU 0x18020000, PLL_INT0=480MHz, PLL_INT1=1.2GHz
207: 2. UART: 0x18710000, 16550 兼容, 60MHz 时钟, divisor≈33
208: 3. 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展, mtvec mode 3, mtvt 向量表
209: 4. GPIO: 0x18700000, PA0/PA1 PIN_FUN=5 for UART0
210: 5. 内存: SRAM @ 0x20000000 (1MB), PSRAM @ 0x30000000 (8MB)

150: }

153:                                    uint32_t offset)

156: }

158: static void dw_i2c_enable(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
159: {
160:   uint32_t reg = dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE);
161:   reg |= DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
162:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE, reg);
163: }
164: 
165: static void dw_i2c_disable(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
166: {
167:   uint32_t reg = dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE);
168:   reg &= ~DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
169:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE, reg);
170: }

172: static int dw_i2c_wait_bus_idle(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
173: {
174:   uint32_t timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
175: 
176:   while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_STATUS) & DW_I2C_STATUS_ACTIVITY)
177:     {
178:       if (--timeout == 0)
179:         {
180:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
181:         }
182: 
183:       up_udelay(1);
184:     }
185: 
186:   return OK;
187: }

191: {

193: 
194:   if (restart)
195:     {
196:       cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_RESTART;
197:     }

201: }

203: static int dw_i2c_xfer_write(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
204:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
205: {
206:   uint32_t timeout;
207:   int i;
208: 
209:   /* 设置目标地址 */
210: 
211:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
212: 
213:   /* 发送写命令 */
214: 
215:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
216:     {
217:       uint32_t cmd = msg->buffer[i];
218: 
219:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
220: 
221:       if (i == msg->length - 1)
222:         {
223:           cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
224:         }
225: 
226:       /* 等待 TX FIFO 有空间 */
227: 
228:       timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
229:       while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_TXFLR) >= DW_I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)

233:               dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
234:               return -EIO;
235:             }
236: 
237:           if (--timeout == 0)
238:             {
239:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
240:             }
241: 
242:           up_udelay(1);
243:         }
244: 
245:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
246:     }
247: 
248:   /* 等待传输完成 */
249: 
250:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
251:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
252:     {
253:       if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
254:         {
255:           dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
256:           return -EIO;
257:         }
258: 
259:       if (--timeout == 0)
260:         {
261:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
262:         }
263: 
264:       up_udelay(1);
265:     }
266: 
267:   /* 清除中断标志 */
268: 
269:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
270: 
271:   return msg->length;
272: }

274: static int dw_i2c_xfer_read(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
275:                             struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
276: {
277:   uint32_t timeout;
278:   int i;
279:   int rx_cnt = 0;
280: 
281:   /* 设置目标地址 */
282: 
283:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
284: 
285:   /* 发送读命令 */
286: 
287:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
288:     {
289:       uint32_t cmd = DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_READ;
290: 
291:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
292: 
293:       if (i == msg->length - 1)
294:         {
295:           cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
296:         }
297: 
298:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
299:     }
300: 
301:   /* 读取数据 */
302: 
303:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
304:     {
305:       timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
306: 
307:       while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_RXFLR) == 0)
308:         {
309:           if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)

312:               return -EIO;
313:             }
314: 
315:           if (--timeout == 0)
316:             {

318:             }

328: 
329:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
330:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
331:     {
332:       if (--timeout == 0)
333:         {
334:           break;
335:         }
336: 
337:       up_udelay(1);
338:     }
339: 
340:   /* 清除中断标志 */
341: 
342:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
343: 
344:   return rx_cnt;
345: }

347: /****************************************************************************
348:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer
349:  *
350:  * Description:
351:  *   执行 I2C 传输
352:  *
353:  ****************************************************************************/
354: 
355: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(struct i2c_master_s *dev,
356:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count)
357: {
358:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv = (struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *)dev;
359:   int ret = 0;
360:   int i;
361: 
362:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
363: 
364:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
365:     {
366:       struct i2c_msg_s *msg = &msgs[i];
367: 
368:       if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
369:         {
370:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_read(priv, msg);
371:         }
372:       else
373:         {
374:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_write(priv, msg);
375:         }
376: 
377:       if (ret < 0)
378:         {
379:           ierr("I2C 传输失败: %d\n", ret);
380:           break;
381:         }
382:     }
383: 
384:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
385:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : count;
386: }
387: 
388: /****************************************************************************
389:  * Public Functions
390:  ****************************************************************************/
391: 
392: /****************************************************************************
393:  * Name: d13x_i2c_initialize
394:  *
395:  * Description:
396:  *   初始化指定的 I2C 总线
397:  *
398:  ****************************************************************************/
399: 
400: int d13x_i2c_initialize(int bus)
401: {
402:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv;
403:   uint32_t reg;
404: 
405:   switch (bus)
406:     {
407: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
408:       case 0:
409:         priv = &g_i2c0_priv;
410:         break;
411: #endif
412: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
413:       case 1:
414:         priv = &g_i2c1_priv;
415:         break;
416: #endif
417: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
418:       case 2:
419:         priv = &g_i2c2_priv;
420:         break;
421: #endif
422:       default:
423:         return -EINVAL;
424:     }
425: 
426:   /* 使能 I2C 模块时钟 */
427: 
428:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
429:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
430:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
431: 
432:   /* 禁用 I2C 以配置 */
433: 
434:   dw_i2c_disable(priv);
435: 
436:   /* 配置为主模式, Fast Mode (400kHz), 重启使能 */
437: 
438:   reg = DW_I2C_CTL_MASTER | DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS | DW_I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
439:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_CTL, reg);
440: 
441:   /* 配置 SCL 时序 (400kHz @ I2C模块时钟)
442:    * 根据 luban-lite HAL, I2C模块时钟为24MHz (I2C_DEFALT_CLOCK)
443:    * FS_SCL_HCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 8 = 22
444:    * FS_SCL_LCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 1 = 29
445:    */
446: 
447:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, 22);
448:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, 29);
449: 
450:   /* 设置 SDA 保持时间 */
451: 
452:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_SDA_HOLD, 12);
453:

147:                                 uint32_t offset, uint32_t value)
148: {
149:   putreg32(value, priv->base + offset);
150: }
151: 
152: static inline uint32_t dw_i2c_read(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
153:                                    uint32_t offset)
154: {
155:   return getreg32(priv->base + offset);
156: }
157: 
158: static void dw_i2c_enable(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
159: {
160:   uint32_t reg = dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE);
161:   reg |= DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
162:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE, reg);
163: }
164: 
165: static void dw_i2c_disable(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
166: {
167:   uint32_t reg = dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE);
168:   reg &= ~DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
169:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE, reg);
170: }
171: 
172: static int dw_i2c_wait_bus_idle(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
173: {
174:   uint32_t timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
175: 
176:   while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_STATUS) & DW_I2C_STATUS_ACTIVITY)
177:     {
178:       if (--timeout == 0)
179:         {
180:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
181:         }
182: 
183:       up_udelay(1);
184:     }
185: 
186:   return OK;
187: }
188: 
189: static int dw_i2c_send_addr(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
190:                             uint16_t addr, bool restart)
191: {
192:   uint32_t cmd = addr & 0x7FF;
193: 
194:   if (restart)
195:     {
196:       cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_RESTART;
197:     }
198: 
199:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
200:   return OK;
201: }
202: 
203: static int dw_i2c_xfer_write(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
204:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
205: {
206:   uint32_t timeout;
207:   int i;
208: 
209:   /* 设置目标地址 */
210: 
211:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
212: 
213:   /* 发送写命令 */
214: 
215:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
216:     {
217:       uint32_t cmd = msg->buffer[i];
218: 
219:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
220: 
221:       if (i == msg->length - 1)
222:         {
223:           cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
224:         }
225: 
226:       /* 等待 TX FIFO 有空间 */
227: 
228:       timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
229:       while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_TXFLR) >= DW_I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
230:         {
231:           if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
232:             {
233:               dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
234:               return -EIO;
235:             }
236: 
237:           if (--timeout == 0)
238:             {
239:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
240:             }
241: 
242:           up_udelay(1);
243:         }
244: 
245:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
246:     }
247: 
248:   /* 等待传输完成 */
249: 
250:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
251:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
252:     {
253:       if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
254:         {
255:           dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
256:           return -EIO;
257:         }
258: 
259:       if (--timeout == 0)
260:         {
261:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
262:         }
263: 
264:       up_udelay(1);
265:     }
266: 
267:   /* 清除中断标志 */
268: 
269:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
270: 
271:   return msg->length;
272: }
273: 
274: static int dw_i2c_xfer_read(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
275:                             struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
276: {
277:   uint32_t timeout;
278:   int i;
279:   int rx_cnt = 0;
280: 
281:   /* 设置目标地址 */
282: 
283:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
284: 
285:   /* 发送读命令 */
286: 
287:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
288:     {
289:       uint32_t cmd = DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_READ;
290: 
291:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
292: 
293:       if (i == msg->length - 1)
294:         {
295:           cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
296:         }
297: 
298:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
299:     }
300: 
301:   /* 读取数据 */
302: 
303:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
304:     {
305:       timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
306: 
307:       while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_RXFLR) == 0)
308:         {
309:           if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
310:             {
311:               dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
312:               return -EIO;
313:             }
314: 
315:           if (--timeout == 0)
316:             {
317:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
318:             }
319: 
320:           up_udelay(1);
321:         }
322: 
323:       msg->buffer[i] = (uint8_t)(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD) & 0xFF);
324:       rx_cnt++;
325:     }
326: 
327:   /* 等待 STOP 检测 */
328: 
329:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
330:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
331:     {
332:       if (--timeout == 0)
333:         {
334:           break;
335:         }
336: 
337:       up_udelay(1);
338:     }
339: 
340:   /* 清除中断标志 */
341: 
342:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
343: 
344:   return rx_cnt;
345: }
346: 
347: /****************************************************************************
348:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer
349:  *
350:  * Description:
351:  *   执行 I2C 传输
352:  *
353:  ****************************************************************************/
354: 
355: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(struct i2c_master_s *dev,
356:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count)
357: {
358:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv = (struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *)dev;
359:   int ret = 0;
360:   int i;
361: 
362:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
363: 
364:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
365:     {
366:       struct i2c_msg_s *msg = &msgs[i];
367: 
368:       if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
369:         {
370:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_read(priv, msg);
371:         }
372:       else
373:         {
374:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_write(priv, msg);
375:         }
376: 
377:       if (ret < 0)
378:         {
379:           ierr("I2C 传输失败: %d\n", ret);
380:           break;
381:         }
382:     }
383: 
384:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
385:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : count;
386: }
387: 
388: /****************************************************************************
389:  * Public Functions
390:  ****************************************************************************/
391: 
392: /****************************************************************************
393:  * Name: d13x_i2c_initialize
394:  *
395:  * Description:
396:  *   初始化指定的 I2C 总线
397:  *
398:  ****************************************************************************/
399: 
400: int d13x_i2c_initialize(int bus)
401: {
402:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv;
403:   uint32_t reg;
404: 
405:   switch (bus)
406:     {
407: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
408:       case 0:
409:         priv = &g_i2c0_priv;
410:         break;
411: #endif
412: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
413:       case 1:
414:         priv = &g_i2c1_priv;
415:         break;
416: #endif
417: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
418:       case 2:
419:         priv = &g_i2c2_priv;
420:         break;
421: #endif
422:       default:
423:         return -EINVAL;
424:     }
425: 
426:   /* 使能 I2C 模块时钟 */
427: 
428:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
429:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
430:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
431: 
432:   /* 禁用 I2C 以配置 */
433: 
434:   dw_i2c_disable(priv);
435: 
436:   /* 配置为主模式, Fast Mode (400kHz), 重启使能 */
437: 
438:   reg = DW_I2C_CTL_MASTER | DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS | DW_I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
439:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_CTL, reg);
440: 
441:   /* 配置 SCL 时序 (400kHz @ I2C模块时钟)
442:    * 根据 luban-lite HAL, I2C模块时钟为24MHz (I2C_DEFALT_CLOCK)
443:    * FS_SCL_HCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 8 = 22
444:    * FS_SCL_LCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 1 = 29
445:    */
446: 
447:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, 22);
448:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, 29);
449: 
450:   /* 设置 SDA 保持时间 */
451: 
452:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_SDA_HOLD, 12);
453: 
454:   /* 设置 TX/RX FIFO 阈值 */
455: 
456:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xFFFF);
457:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_MASK, 0);
458: 
459:   /* 使能 I2C */
460: 
461:   dw_i2c_enable(priv);
462: 
463:   /* 初始化互斥锁 */
464: 
465:   nxmutex_init(&priv->lock);
466: 
467:   iinfo("I2C%d 初始化完成, 基地址=0x%08X\n", bus, priv->base);
468: 
469:   return OK;
470: }
471: 
472: /****************************************************************************
473:  * Name: d13x_i2c_get_bus
474:  *
475:  * Description:
476:  *   获取指定 I2C 总线的 master 接口
477:  *
478:  ****************************************************************************/
479: 
480: struct i2c_master_s *d13x_i2c_get_bus(int bus)
481: {
482:   switch (bus)
483:     {
484: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
485:       case 0:
486:         return &g_i2c0_priv.dev;
487: #endif
488: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
489:       case 1:
490:         return &g_i2c1_priv.dev;
491: #endif
492: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
493:       case 2:
494:         return &g_i2c2_priv.dev;
495: #endif
496:       default:
497:         return NULL;
498:     }
499: }

1: D13x 芯片全参数、信息与方案文档
2: 芯片厂商：广东匠芯创科技有限公司（ArtInChip）
3: 芯片系列：D13x
4: 内核架构：RISC-V（平头哥玄铁 E907）
5: 文档版本：v1.0
6: 更新日期：2026-06-13
7: 
8: === 芯片总览 ===
9: D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。
10: 
11: 核心特性：
12: - CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
13: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
14: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
15: - Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
16: - 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
17: - 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
18: - 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
19: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
20: - 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC
21: - USB: 1×USB 2.0 HS-USB
22: - 串口: 8×UART
23: - SPI: 4×SPI
24: - I2C: 3×I2C
25: - CAN: 2×CAN 2.0B
26: - PWM: 8 路 PWM + 24 路 EPWM + 6 路 CAP
27: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12 通道）
28: - 封装: QFN68 / QFN88 / QFN100
29: 
30: === 本次大赛使用型号 ===
31: D133EBS（衡山派开发板），QFN100 封装，1MB SRAM + 8MB PSRAM
32: 
33: === CPU 内核参数 ===
34: 架构: RISC-V
35: 指令集: RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]
36: 位宽: 32 位
37: 主频: 480MHz @ 1.1V
38: 流水线: 5 级按序流水线
39: 浮点单元: 可选单精度 F / 双精度 D
40: 中断控制器: CLIC（Core Local Interrupt Controller）
41: 
42: E907 与标准 RISC-V 差异：
43: - 向量表 CSR: mtvec（mode 3）+ mtvt 双 CSR
44: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
45: - TCM: ITCM + DTCM
46: - 栈保护: mscratch + SPSWAPEN 扩展
47: - FPU 控制: MXSTATUS 扩展
48: - Cache 控制: T-Head 扩展的 icache_enable/dcache_enable
49: 
50: === 存储系统 ===
51: 片上存储:
52: - BROM: 64KB（Boot ROM，出厂固化）
53: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB
54: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封，16 位控制器）
55: - ITCM: 可配置，地址 0x30040000
56: - DTCM: 可配置，地址 0x30060000
57: 
58: 外部存储接口:
59: - QSPI: 2 套
60: - eMMC: eMMC 4.5
61: - SD/SDIO: SD 3.01 / SDIO 3.0
62: 
63: 启动方式: SD Card → SPI NOR → SPI NAND → eMMC
64: 
65: === 内存地址映射 ===
66: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
67: SRAM: 0x20000000
68: PSRAM: 0x30000000
69: ITCM: 0x30040000
70: DTCM: 0x30060000
71: 外设区域: 0x18000000~
72: 
73: 外设基地址:
74: - CMU: 0x18020000
75: - GPIO: 0x18700000
76: - UART0: 0x18710000
77: 
78: === 时钟系统（CMU）===
79: 时钟源: OSC24M（内部振荡器）24MHz
80: 
81: PLL 配置:
82: - PLL_INT0: 480MHz（CPU 时钟）
83: - PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz（总线/模块时钟源）
84: 
85: 模块时钟:
86: - CPU: PLL_INT0 = 480MHz
87: - AXI/AHB: PLL_INT1 ÷6 = 200MHz
88: - APB0: PLL_INT1 ÷12 = 100MHz
89: - UART0: PLL_INT1 ÷20 = 60MHz
90: 
91: CMU 初始化流程:
92: 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 (PLL_IN = 0x180200A4, bit1=1)
93: 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO (PLL_COM = 0x180200A0)
94: 3. 配置 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49)
95: 4. 配置 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19)
96: 5. 总线时钟: AXI/AHB=200M, APB0=100M
97: 6. CPU 时钟: 480MHz
98: 7. 打开 GPIO 时钟
99: 8. 打开 UART0 时钟 (60MHz)
100: 
101: === UART 详情 ===
102: 基地址: 0x18710000
103: 模块时钟: 60MHz
104: 波特率: 115200 8N1
105: divisor = 60M / (16 × 115200) ≈ 33
106: 控制器类型: 16550 兼容
107: IRQ: 76
108: 调试串口引脚: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX)，PIN_FUN = 5
109: 
110: 16550 寄存器偏移:
111: - RBR/THR: 0x00
112: - DLL: 0x00
113: - DLH: 0x04
114: - FCR: 0x08
115: - LCR: 0x0C
116: - MCR: 0x10
117: - LSR: 0x14
118: - MSR: 0x18
119: 
120: === GPIO 详情 ===
121: 基地址: 0x18700000
122: 时钟: APB0 总线时钟, CLK_GPIO @ 0x1802083C
123: 
124: === 启动流程 ===
125: 1. BROM (64KB) 扫描启动源
126: 2. SPL/Bootloader 初始化 DDR/PSRAM
127: 3. startup_gcc.S (Reset_Handler):
128:    - save_boot_params
129:    - 初始化 gp
130:    - 设置 mtvec = Default_Handler | 3 (mode 3)
131:    - 设置 mtvt = __Vectors
132:    - 设置 sp = g_top_irqstack
133:    - 使能 ICache/DCache
134:    - 使能 TCM (ITCM + DTCM)
135:    - 配置 SRAM1
136:    - 配置 PSRAM 属性
137:    - 清零 BSS
138:    - SystemInit()
139:    - 跳转 entry()/main()
140: 4. SystemInit(): FPU, Cache, CLIC, tick
141: 5. aic_clk_init(): 时钟初始化
142: 6. board_uart_init(): 引脚复用
143: 7. uart_init(): 16550 初始化
144: 8. 系统就绪
145: 
146: === 向量表结构 ===
147: 表长度: 100 项 × 4 字节
148: 位置: .data 段（可写 RAM）
149: 通过 mtvt CSR 绑定
150: 
151: === 开发板：衡山派 D133EBS ===
152: - 主控: D133EBS，QFN100 封装
153: - SRAM: 1MB, PSRAM: 8MB
154: - NOR FLASH: 16MB
155: - USB: 1×USB2.0（Type-C，支持烧录调试）
156: - 调试: 1×JTAG
157: - 串口: 1×UART0（115200 8N1）
158: - TF-Card: 1×TF-Card 接口
159: - 显示: LVDS + RGB 接口、电容式触摸屏接口
160: - 屏幕: 4.3 寸电容触摸屏（预装）
161: - 摄像头: 1×DVP 摄像头接口
162: - 以太网: 1×RMII 百兆以太网
163: - WiFi: 1×SDIO WIFI
164: - 电源: 5V Type-C 或 5~12V 直流
165: 
166: === SDK ===
167: Luban-Lite (RT-Thread): https://gitee.com/artinchip/luban-lite
168: 关键源文件:
169: - startup_gcc.S: 启动汇编
170: - vectors.S: 默认异常处理

172: - aic_clk.c: 时钟初始化

176: - aic_drv_irq.c: 中断驱动
177: - gcc_aic.ld: 链接脚本
178: 
179: 工具链: RISC-V GCC (xPack 或 SiFive)
180: 烧录: AiBurn / AiBurnPro
181: 调试: OpenOCD + GDB
182: 
183: === openvela 适配方案 ===
184: 需要创建的文件:
185: 
186: 芯片层 (chips/d13x/):
187: - chip.h, include/chip.h, include/irq.h

58:         return -RT_ERROR;

172: static int16_t pre_x[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { -1, -1, -1, -1, -1 };
173: static int16_t pre_y[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { -1, -1, -1, -1, -1 };
174: static int16_t pre_w[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { -1, -1, -1, -1, -1 };

178: static void gt911_touch_up(void *buf, int8_t id)
179: {
180:     read_data = (struct rt_touch_data *)buf;
181: 
182:     if (s_tp_dowm[id] == 1) {
183:         s_tp_dowm[id] = 0;
184:         read_data[id].event = RT_TOUCH_EVENT_UP;
185:     } else {
186:         read_data[id].event = RT_TOUCH_EVENT_NONE;
187:     }
188: 
189:     read_data[id].timestamp = rt_touch_get_ts();
190:     read_data[id].width = pre_w[id];
191:     read_data[id].x_coordinate = pre_x[id];
192:     read_data[id].y_coordinate = pre_y[id];
193:     read_data[id].track_id = id;
194: 
195:     pre_x[id] = -1; /* last point is none */
196:     pre_y[id] = -1;
197:     pre_w[id] = -1;
198: }

200: static void gt911_touch_down(void *buf, int8_t id, int16_t x, int16_t y,
201:                              int16_t w)
202: {
203:     read_data = (struct rt_touch_data *)buf;
204: 
205:     if (s_tp_dowm[id] == 1) {
206:         read_data[id].event = RT_TOUCH_EVENT_MOVE;
207:     } else {
208:         read_data[id].event = RT_TOUCH_EVENT_DOWN;
209:         s_tp_dowm[id] = 1;
210:     }
211: 
212:     read_data[id].timestamp = rt_touch_get_ts();
213:     read_data[id].width = w;
214:     read_data[id].x_coordinate = x;
215:     read_data[id].y_coordinate = y;
216:     read_data[id].track_id = id;
217: 
218:     pre_x[id] = x; /* save last point */
219:     pre_y[id] = y;
220:     pre_w[id] = w;
221: }

223: static rt_size_t gt911_read_point(struct rt_touch_device *touch, void *buf,
224:                                   rt_size_t read_num)
225: {
226:     rt_uint8_t point_status = 0;
227:     rt_uint8_t touch_num = 0;
228:     rt_uint8_t write_buf[3];
229:     rt_uint8_t cmd[2];
230:     rt_uint8_t read_buf[8 * GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
231:     rt_uint8_t read_index;
232:     int8_t read_id = 0;
233:     int16_t input_x = 0;
234:     int16_t input_y = 0;
235:     int16_t input_w = 0;
236: 
237:     static rt_uint8_t pre_touch = 0;
238:     static int8_t pre_id[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
239: 
240:     rt_memset(buf, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_data) * read_num);
241: 
242:     /* point status register */
243:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
244:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
245: 
246:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, &point_status, 1) != RT_EOK) {
247:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
248:         read_num = 0;
249:         goto exit_;
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (point_status == 0) /* no data */
253:     {
254:         read_num = 0;
255:         goto exit_;
256:     }
257: 
258:     if ((point_status & 0x80) == 0) /* data is not ready */
259:     {
260:         read_num = 0;
261:         goto exit_;
262:     }
263: 
264:     touch_num = point_status & 0x0f; /* get point num */
265: 
266:     if (touch_num > GT911_MAX_TOUCH) /* point num is not correct */
267:     {
268:         read_num = 0;
269:         goto exit_;
270:     }
271: 
272:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_POINT1_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
273:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_POINT1_REG & 0xFF);
274: 
275:     /* read point num is touch_num */
276:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, read_buf,
277:                         read_num * GT911_POINT_INFO_NUM) != RT_EOK) {
278:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
279:         read_num = 0;
280:         goto exit_;
281:     }
282: 
283:     if (pre_touch > touch_num) /* point up */
284:     {
285:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
286:             rt_uint8_t j;
287: 
288:             for (j = 0; j < touch_num; j++) /* this time touch num */
289:             {
290:                 read_id = read_buf[j * 8] & 0x0F;
291: 
292:                 if (pre_id[read_index] == read_id) /* this id is not free */
293:                     break;
294: 
295:                 if (j >= touch_num - 1) {
296:                     rt_uint8_t up_id;
297:                     up_id = pre_id[read_index];
298:                     gt911_touch_up(buf, up_id);
299:                 }
300:             }
301:         }
302:     }
303: 
304:     if (touch_num) /* point down */
305:     {
306:         rt_uint8_t off_set;
307: 
308:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < touch_num; read_index++) {
309:             off_set = read_index * 8;
310:             read_id = read_buf[off_set] & 0x0f;
311:             pre_id[read_index] = read_id;
312:             input_x =
313:                 read_buf[off_set + 1] | (read_buf[off_set + 2] << 8); /* x */
314:             input_y =
315:                 read_buf[off_set + 3] | (read_buf[off_set + 4] << 8); /* y */
316:             input_w =
317:                 read_buf[off_set + 5] | (read_buf[off_set + 6] << 8); /* size */
318: 
319:             gt911_touch_down(buf, read_id, input_x, input_y, input_w);
320:         }
321:     } else if (pre_touch) {
322:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
323:             gt911_touch_up(buf, pre_id[read_index]);
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pre_touch = touch_num;
328: 
329: exit_:
330:     write_buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
331:     write_buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
332:     write_buf[2] = 0x00;
333:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, write_buf, 3);
334: 
335:     return read_num;
336: }

338: static rt_err_t gt911_control(struct rt_touch_device *touch, int cmd, void *arg)
339: {
340:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_ID) {
341:         return gt911_get_product_id(&gt911_client, arg, 6);
342:     }
343: 
344:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_INFO) {
345:         return gt911_get_info(&gt911_client, arg);
346:     }
347: 
348:     rt_uint8_t buf[4];
349:     rt_uint8_t i = 0;
350:     rt_uint8_t *config;
351: 
352:     config =
353:         (rt_uint8_t *)rt_calloc(1, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_REGITER_LEN);
354:     if (config == RT_NULL) {
355:         LOG_D("malloc config memory failed\n");
356:         return -RT_ERROR;
357:     }
358: 
359:     config[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CONFIG_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
360:     config[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CONFIG_REG & 0xFF);
361: 
362:     memcpy(&config[2], GT911_CFG_TBL, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL));
363: 
364:     switch (cmd) {
365:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_RANGE: {
366:             rt_uint16_t x_range;
367: 
368:             x_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
369:             config[4] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range >> 8);
370:             config[3] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range & 0xff);
371: 
372:             GT911_CFG_TBL[2] = config[4];
373:             GT911_CFG_TBL[1] = config[3];
374:             break;
375:         }
376:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_Y_RANGE: {
377:             rt_uint16_t y_range;
378: 
379:             y_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
380:             config[6] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range >> 8);
381:             config[5] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range & 0xff);
382: 
383:             GT911_CFG_TBL[4] = config[6];
384:             GT911_CFG_TBL[3] = config[5];
385:             break;
386:         }
387:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_TO_Y: {
388:             config[8] ^= (1 << 3);
389:             break;
390:         }
391:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_MODE: {
392:             rt_uint16_t trig_type;
393:             trig_type = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
394: 
395:             switch (trig_type) {
396:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX:
397:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
398:                     break;
399:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDONLY:
400:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
401:                     config[8] |= 0x02;
402:                     break;
403:                 default:
404:                     break;
405:             }
406:             break;
407:         }
408:         default: {
409:             break;
410:         }
411:     }
412: 
413:     if (gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, config,
414:                         sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN) != RT_EOK) {
415:         LOG_D("send config failed");
416:         return -1;
417:     }
418: 
419:     buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CHECK_SUM >> 8) & 0xFF);
420:     buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CHECK_SUM & 0xFF);
421:     buf[2] = 0;
422: 
423:     for (i = GT911_ADDR_LEN; i < sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN; i++) {
424:         buf[GT911_ADDR_LEN] += config[i];
425:     }
426: 
427:     buf[2] = (~buf[2]) + 1;
428:     buf[3] = 1;
429: 
430:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, buf, 4);
431:     rt_free(config);
432: 
433:     return RT_EOK;
434: }

441: static int rt_hw_gt911_init(const char *name, struct rt_touch_config *cfg)
442: {
443:     struct rt_touch_device *touch_device = RT_NULL;
444: 
445:     touch_device =
446:         (struct rt_touch_device *)rt_malloc(sizeof(struct rt_touch_device));
447:     if (touch_device == RT_NULL) {
448:         LOG_E("touch device malloc fail");
449:         return -RT_ERROR;
450:     }
451:     rt_memset((void *)touch_device, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_device));
452: 
453:     /* hw init*/
454:     // rst output 0
455:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
456:     rt_pin_write(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_LOW);
457:     rt_thread_delay(10);
458: 
459:     // irq output 0
460:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
461:     rt_pin_write(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_LOW);
462: 
463:     rt_thread_delay(2);
464:     // rst output 1
465:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
466:     rt_pin_write(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_HIGH);
467: 
468:     rt_thread_delay(5);
469:     // rst input
470:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_INPUT);
471: 
472:     //irq output 0
473:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
474:     rt_pin_write(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_LOW);
475: 
476:     rt_thread_delay(50);
477: 
478:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_INPUT);
479: 
480:     gt911_client.bus =
481:         (struct rt_i2c_bus_device *)rt_device_find(cfg->dev_name);
482: 
483:     if (gt911_client.bus == RT_NULL) {
484:         LOG_E("Can't find %s device", cfg->dev_name);
485:         return -RT_ERROR;
486:     }
487: 
488:     if (rt_device_open((rt_device_t)gt911_client.bus, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDWR) !=
489:         RT_EOK) {
490:         LOG_E("open %s device failed", cfg->dev_name);
491:         return -RT_ERROR;
492:     }
493: 
494:     gt911_client.client_addr = GT911_ADDRESS_HIGH;
495: 
496:     /* register touch device */
497:     touch_device->info.type = RT_TOUCH_TYPE_CAPACITANCE;
498:     touch_device->info.vendor = RT_TOUCH_VENDOR_GT;
499:     rt_memcpy(&touch_device->config, cfg, sizeof(struct rt_touch_config));
500:     touch_device->ops = &gt911_touch_ops;
501: 
502:     if (RT_EOK != rt_hw_touch_register(touch_device, name, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX, RT_NULL)) {
503:         LOG_E("touch device gt911 init failed !!!");
504:         return -RT_ERROR;
505:     }
506: 
507:     LOG_I("touch device gt911 init success");
508:     return RT_EOK;
509: }

bad structure. 244: */ 245: 246: inode_semtake(); 247: ret = inode_reserve(path, &node); 248: if (ret >= 0) 249: { 250: /* We have it, now populate it with driver specific information. 251: * NOTE 负责硬件的实际操作，例如寄存器读写和中断处理。 314: - 在中断处理函数中，会回调 Upper half 的接口，例如通过消息队列通知上层应用数据已准备好。 315: 316: 2. 通用框架（Upper Half）： 绿色部分（由 openvela 提供） 317: 318: - 提供系统调用接口，例如 `open`、`read` 等。 319: - 在实现 灵活性：下半部分针对不同硬件实现具体的操作接口，便于适配多种平台。 337: - 模块化：上下半部分职责分离，降低耦合性，便于代码维护和扩展。 338: 339: 通过这种分层设计，openvela 的驱动开发既能满足硬件适配的需求，又能保持代码的通用性和可维护性。 340: 341: #### I3C 驱动框架 342: 343: I3C 相对于 I2C 驱动模型 356: 357: - 下层驱动 (Lower-Half): 这一层是与芯片硬件直接关联的部分。作为驱动开发者，您的主要任务是填充 `struct rtc_ops_s` 结构体。该结构体定义了一套标准的操作函数（如初始化、读取时间、设置时间），将特定硬件的行为抽象出来。 358: - 上层驱动 (Upper-Half): 这一层是 openvela 提供的通用逻辑层。它负责创建标准的字符设备节点（如 `/dev/rtc0`），并将来自用户空间的 VFS 文件操作（如 `ioctl`）转换为对下层 `rtc_ops_s` 接口的调用。 359: 360: - 访问路径 361: 362: - 用户空间访问 (Application Level) 363: - 应用程序通过操作 `/dev/rtc0` 设备节点与 RTC 通信。 364: - VFS、直接调用下层驱动操作的快捷路径，通常用于系统初始化或对性能敏感的场景。它们通过获取下层驱动的句柄（handle）来直接操作硬件。 368: 369: 370: 371: 372: 373: #### IR 驱动框架 374: 375: IR 驱动框架采用了业界标准的**分层架构**设计，将驱动分为上层(Upper Half)和下层 (Lower Half)两部分。这种设计将硬件无关的通用逻辑与硬件相关的具体实现分离开来，极大地提高了代码的可移植性和可复用性： 376: 377: 1. **上层 (Upper Half)：通用逻辑层** 378: 379: 上层负责实现独立于具体硬件的通用驱动核心，为内核及用户空间应用提供标准的交互接口。其主要职责包括： 380: 381: - 设备注册：将驱动注册为标准的字符设备（例如 # 驱动开发

\[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/driver/driver-troubleshooting-guide.md) | 简体中文 \]

## 一、驱动内部结构

openvela 的驱动框架相对简单，并未提供像 Linux 系统中那样复杂的驱动模型（例如 Device、Driver、Bus、Class 等）。相较于 Linux，openvela 的驱动框架具有以下特点：

- 驱动注册接口：通过简单的驱动注册接口，将驱动注册到VFS文件系统中。
- 函数集实现：实现  `file_operations` 操作函数集，供上层调用。
- 系统调用支持：上层应用通过标准的系统调用，间接调用底层驱动完成设备操作。

这种简化的设计使得 openvela 的驱动框架更易于理解和实现。

### 1、驱动类型与层次结构

openvela 支持多种设备驱动，主要分为以下几种类型：

- 字符设备驱动：zero、null、sensor、adc等
- 块设备驱动：emmc，sd card、bch等

1: # 适配 I2C Master 驱动
2: 
3: [ [English](../../../../../en/device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/I2C/i2c_master_guide.md) | 简体中文 ]
4: 
5: 本文档介绍如何为 openvela 适配一个标准的 I2C Master 驱动，使其能够作为总线主设备工作。
6: 
7: ## 一、驱动框架层级
8: 
9: I2C Master 驱动的开发涉及驱动层、板级层和应用层，它们之间的协作关系如下：
10: 
11: ### 驱动层 (Driver)
12: 
13: 负责实现芯片相关的 I2C 底层硬件操作。此层需要封装硬件细节，并向上层提供一个标准化的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄。
14: 
15: ```C
16: /* 1. 定义底层操作函数集 */
17: static const struct i2c_ops_s bl602_i2c_ops =
18: {
19:     .transfer = bl602_i2c_transfer,
20: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
21:     .reset = bl602_i2c_reset
22: #endif
23: };
24: 
25: /* 2. 定义私有数据结构，包含操作函数集和配置信息 */
26: static struct bl602_i2c_priv_s bl602_i2c0_priv =
27: {
28:     .ops      = &bl602_i2c_ops,
29:     .config   = &bl602_i2c0_config,
30: };
31: 
32: /* 3. 实现初始化函数，返回标准的 I2C Master 句柄 */
33: struct i2c_master_s *bl602_i2cbus_initialize(int port)
34: {
35:     priv = (struct bl602_i2c_priv_s *)&bl602_i2c0_priv;
36:     
37:     return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
38: }
39: ```
40: 
41: ### 板级层 (Board)
42: 
43: 在系统启动阶段，调用驱动层的初始化函数获取 I2C 总线句柄。根据需求，可以选择性地将该总线注册为字符设备（如 `/dev/i2c-0`），或直接传递给其他内核驱动（如传感器驱动）使用。
44: 
45: ```C
46: /* 获取 I2C 总线句柄 */
47: i2c_bus = bl602_i2cbus_initialize(0);
48: 
49: /* 将总线注册为 /dev/i2c0 */
50: i2c_register(i2c_bus, 0);
51: ```
52: 
53: ### 应用层 (Application)
54: 
55: 通过标准的 POSIX 文件接口（`open`, `ioctl` 等）访问已注册的 `/dev/i2c-N` 设备节点，从而与挂载在总线上的 I2C 从设备通信。
56: 
57: ```C
58: fd = open("/dev/i2c", O_RDWR);
59: ioctl(fd, );
60: ...
61: ```
62: 
63: ## 二、适配南向接口 (Lower Half)
64: 
65: 南向接口适配的核心任务是实现芯片的底层驱动，并提供一个标准的初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`，其中 `xxx` 代表芯片（Chip）名称。
66: 
67: ### 1、Kconfig 配置选项
68: 
69: 请在 Kconfig 中启用以下配置项以支持 I2C Master 驱动：
70: 
71: ```Makefile
72: CONFIG_I2C=y          # 必需，启用 I2C 子系统
73: CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y   # 必需，启用 I2C 字符设备驱动上层
74: CONFIG_I2C_RESET=y    # 可选，如果需要支持总线复位功能
75: ```
76: 
77: ### 2、核心数据结构
78: 
79: openvela I2C Master 驱动围绕 `struct i2c_master_s` 和 `struct i2c_ops_s` 这两个核心结构进行抽象。
80: 
81: ```C
82: /*
83:  * I2C Master 操作函数集。
84:  * 驱动开发者需要实现其中的函数指针，特别是 transfer 函数。
85:  */
86: struct i2c_ops_s
87: {
88:   /* 核心传输函数，必需 */
89:   CODE int (*transfer)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev,
90:                        FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count);
91: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
92:   /* 可选的总线复位函数 */
93:   CODE int (*reset)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev);
94: #endif
95: };
96: 
97: /*
98:  * I2C Master 设备句柄。
99:  * 这是南向驱动向上层提供的标准接口。
100:  * 开发者通常会定义一个包含此结构的私有设备结构体。
101:  */
102: struct i2c_master_s
103: {
104:   FAR const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* 指向操作函数集的指针 */
105: };
106: ```
107: 
108: ### 3、驱动入口函数说明
109: 
110: 您需要根据下表的要求，在芯片驱动文件（`xxx_i2c.c`）中实现 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()` 函数。
111: 
112: | **项目**     | **描述**                                                                                                                                                             |
113: | :----------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
114: | **函数原型** | `struct i2c_master_s *xxx_i2cbus_initialize(int port)`                                                                                                               |
115: | **参数**     | `port`：I2C 总线端口号。如果芯片支持多路 I2C，您需要根据此参数进行多路配置。                                                                                         |
116: | **返回值**   | 返回一个标准的 `i2c_master_s` 操作句柄。如果初始化失败，则返回 `NULL`。                                                                                              |
117: | **实现内容** | 初始化 I2C 控制器所需的时钟和 GPIO。如果使用中断模式，还需配置并使能中断。填充并返回一个包含 `transfer` 函数指针的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄，用于处理上层的数据传输请求。 |
118: | **文件位置** | chip 路径下的 `xxx_i2c.c`，`xxx` 为 chip 名称。                                                                                                                      |
119: | **调用位置** | board 路径下的 `xxx_bringup.c` 里调用，`xxx` 为 `board` 名字。                                                                                                       |
120: 
121: ### 4、适配实现步骤
122: 
123: 本节通过代码示例，展示如何分步完成 I2C Master 驱动的适配。
124: 
125: - **参考实现**：[bl602_i2c.c](https://github.com/apache/nuttx/blob/master/arch/risc-v/src/bl602/bl602_i2c.c)
126: 
127: #### 步骤一：定义私有设备结构体
128: 
129: 我们强烈建议您定义一个私有结构体，用于封装 I2C 控制器的所有状态信息，例如配置、锁、信号量以及运行时数据等。以下是 `bl602` 芯片的私有结构体示例：
130: 
131: > **核心要点：结构体成员布局** 为确保类型安全转换，私有结构体的**第一个成员**必须是 `const struct i2c_ops_s *ops;`。这使得框架可以将您的私有结构体指针安全地转换为标准的 `struct i2c_master_s *` 句柄。
132: 
133: <details>
134: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
135: 
136: ```C
137: /* 位于: arch/risc-v/src/bl602/bl602_i2c.c */
138: 
139: /* bl602 I2C 驱动的私有数据结构 */
140: struct bl602_i2c_priv_s
141: {
142:   /* 必须作为第一个成员，以兼容 i2c_master_s 类型转换 */
143:   const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* Standard I2C operations */
144: 
145:   /* 端口配置 */
146:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
147: 
148:   /* 状态与同步机制 */
149:   uint8_t  subflag;   /* Sub address flag */
150:   uint32_t subaddr;   /* Sub address */
151:   uint8_t  sublen;    /* Sub address length */
152:   mutex_t  lock;      /* Mutual exclusion mutex */
153:   sem_t    sem_isr;   /* Interrupt wait semaphore */
154: 
155:   /* 运行时数据 */
156:   /* I2C work state */
157:   uint8_t i2cstate;
158: 
159:   struct i2c_msg_s *msgv; /* Message list */
160: 
161:   uint8_t msgid; /* Current message ID */
162:   ssize_t bytes; /* Processed data bytes */
163:   int     refs;  /* Reference count */
164: };
165: ```
166: 
167: </details>
168: 
169: #### 步骤二：实现初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`
170: 
171: 此函数负责完成硬件初始化，并返回一个配置好的 I2C Master 句柄。
172: 
173: <details>
174: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
175: 
176: ```C
177: struct i2c_master_s *bl602_i2cbus_initialize(int port)
178: {
179:   struct bl602_i2c_priv_s         *priv;
180:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
181: 
182:   /* 1. 根据 port 号获取对应的私有设备实例 */
183:   switch (port)
184:     {
185: #ifdef CONFIG_BL602_I2C0
186:     case 0:
187:       priv = (struct bl602_i2c_priv_s *)&bl602_i2c0_priv;
188:       break;
189: #endif
190:     default:
191:       return NULL;
192:     }
193: 
194:   config = priv->config;
195: /*************************************************
196: 此部分是把IIC配置为中断，不配置中断可以把此部分替换成IIC GPIO以及时钟初始化
197:   
198:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
199:   if (++priv->refs > 1)
200:   {
201:     nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
202:     return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
203:   }
204: 
205:   bl602_configgpio(BOARD_I2C_SCL);
206:   bl602_configgpio(BOARD_I2C_SDA);
207: 
208:   bl602_i2c_set_freq(config->clk_freq);
209:   bl602_i2c_disable();
210:   up_enable_irq(BL602_IRQ_I2C);
211:   bl602_i2c_intmask(I2C_INT_ALL, 1);
212:   irq_attach(BL602_IRQ_I2C, bl602_i2c_irq, priv);
213: **************************************************/
214:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
215: 
216:    /* 2. 返回私有结构体指针，并强制转换为标准句柄类型 */
217:   return (struct i2c_master_s *)priv;
218: }
219: ```
220: 
221: </details>
222: 
223: #### 步骤三：在板级代码中调用
224: 
225: 在板级初始化代码（`xxx_bringup.c`）中，调用芯片驱动提供的初始化函数，并根据需要将 I2C 总线注册为系统设备。
226: 
227: - **参考实现**：[bl602_bringup.c](https://github.com/apache/nuttx/blob/master/boards/risc-v/bl602/bl602evb/src/bl602_bringup.c)
228: 
229: <details>
230: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
231: 
232: ```C
233: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C
234:   /* 初始化 I2C 总线 0 */
235:   i2c_bus = bl602_i2cbus_initialize(0);
236:   
237:   /* 2. (可选) 将总线注册为 /dev/i2c-0 设备节点 */
238:   i2c_register(i2c_bus, 0);
239: #endif
240: ```
241: 
242: </details>
243: 
244: **`i2c_register()`** **使用说明**
245: 
246: - **注册为设备节点**：调用 `i2c_register(i2c_bus, N)` 会创建字符设备节点 `/dev/i2c-N`。这使得用户空间应用（如测试程序、`i2ctool`）能通过标准文件接口访问 I2C 总线。
247: - **仅供内核使用**：如果某个 I2C 总线仅供内核中的其他驱动（如板载传感器）使用，您可以不调用 `i2c_register()`。直接将 `i2c_bus` 句柄传递给相应驱动的注册函数即可。
248: 
249: ## 三、北向使用
250: 
251: 当 I2C Master 驱动被成功注册后，系统会创建 `/dev/i2c-N` 格式的设备节点（例如 `/dev/i2c-0`, `/dev/i2c-1` 等）。应用程序可以通过这些设备节点，使用标准的 POSIX 文件接口与挂载在 I2C 总线上的从设备进行通信。
252: 
253: ### 1、API 列表
254: 
255: I2C 设备节点支持以下标准文件操作接口：
256: 
257: | **API**                                                  | **描述**                                                                |
258: | :------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
259: | `int open(FAR const char *path, int oflag, ...);`        | 打开 I2C 设备节点，例如 `"/dev/i2c-0"`。                                |
260: | `int  close(int `*`fd`*`);`                              | 关闭已打开的设备文件描述符。                                            |
261: | `int ioctl(int fd, int req, ...)`                        | **核心通信接口**。通过发送特定命令来执行 I2C 读写、总线复位等复杂操作。 |
262: | `ssize_t read(int fd, ...)` `ssize_t write(int fd, ...)` | **暂未使用**。                                                          |
263: 
264: ### 2、`ioctl()` 核心接口
265: 
266: `ioctl()` 是与 I2C 设备进行数据交互的主要方式。openvela 定义了以下标准 `ioctl` 命令：
267: 
268: #### `I2CIOC_TRANSFER`
269: 
270: 执行一次或多次 I2C 消息传输。这是最核心、最常用的命令。它使用 `struct i2c_transfer_s` 结构体来描述整个传输任务。
271: 
272: ```C
273: /* 定义一个 I2C 传输任务，可包含一个或多个消息 */
274: struct i2c_transfer_s
275: {
276:   FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgv; /* Array of I2C messages for the transfer */
277:   size_t msgc;                /* Number of messages in the array. */
278: };
279: ```
280: 
281: 每个 I2C 消息由 `struct i2c_msg_s` 定义，用于描述单次读或写操作：
282: 
283: ```C
284: #define I2C_M_READ           0x0001 /* Read data, from slave to master */
285: #define I2C_M_NOSTOP         0x0040 /* Message should not end with a STOP */
286: #define I2C_M_NOSTART        0x0080 /* Message should not begin with a START */
287: 
288: struct i2c_msg_s
289: {
290:   uint32_t frequency;         /* I2C frequency */
291:   uint16_t addr;              /* Slave address (7- or 10-bit) */
292:   uint16_t flags;             /* See I2C_M_* definitions */
293:   FAR uint8_t *buffer;        /* Buffer to be transferred */
294:   ssize_t length;             /* Length of the buffer in bytes */
295: };
296: ```
297: 
298: #### `CONFIG_I2C_RESET`
299: 
300: 复位 I2C 总线。此命令在总线锁死或出现异常时非常有用。要使用此功能，必须在 Kconfig 中启用 `CONFIG_I2C_RESET`。调用时无需第三个参数。
301: 
302: ### 3、复合传输示例：读取传感器寄存器
303: 
304: 本节提供一个完整的示例，演示如何执行一次**复合传输 (Combined Transfer)** 来读取 I2C 设备的寄存器值。这是与 I2C 传感器等设备通信的典型场景，其过程分为两步：
305: 
306: 1. **写操作**：向从设备发送要读取的**寄存器地址**。
307: 2. **读操作**：紧接着从该寄存器**读取数据**。
308: 
309: #### 步骤一：Kconfig 配置
310: 
311: 确保您的项目中已启用以下配置：
312: 
313: ```Makefile
314: CONFIG_I2C=y
315: CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y
316: ```
317: 
318: #### 步骤二：读写示例代码
319: 
320: 以下代码从指定的 I2C 从机地址和寄存器地址读取一个字节的数据。
321: 
322: <details>
323: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
324: 
325: ```C
326: #include <stdio.h>
327: #include <fcntl.h>
328: #include <sys/types.h>
329: #include <sys/stat.h>
330: #include <sys/ioctl.h>
331: #include <nuttx/i2c/i2c_master.h>
332: 
333: // 含义：使用 /dev/i2c-8，访问从机地址 0x68，读取寄存器 0x00 的值
334: //./i2c_test.out /dev/i2c-8 0x68 0x60
335: 
336: 
337: int main(int argc, char **argv)
338: {
339:   int fd,ret;
340:   uint8_t val;
341:   char dev_name[20];
342:   unsigned int slave_address,reg_address;
343:   struct i2c_transfer_s work;
344: 
345:   snprintf(dev_name, sizeof(dev_name),"%s", argv[1]);
346: 
347:   /* 1. 打开 I2C 设备节点 */
348:   fd = open(dev_name, O_RDWR);
349:   if (fd < 0)
350:    {
351:      printf("open failed: %d\n", fd);
352:      return fd;
353:    }
354: 
355:   /* 2. 准备 I2C 消息 */
356:   work.msgc = 2;
357:   work.msgv = (struct i2c_msg_s *)malloc(work.msgc * sizeof(struct i2c_msg_s));
358:   if (NULL == work.msgv)
359:     {
360:       printf("Memory alloc error\n");
361:       close(fd);
362:       return -1;
363:     }
364: 
365:   sscanf(argv[2], "%x", &slave_address);
366:   sscanf(argv[3], "%x", &reg_address);
367: 
368:   val = reg_address;
369:   /* 消息 1: 写操作，发送要读取的寄存器地址 */
370:   (work.msgv[0]).frequency=400000;
371:   (work.msgv[0]).length = 1;
372:   (work.msgv[0]).addr = slave_address;
373:   (work.msgv[0]).buffer = &val;
374:   (work.msgv[0]).flags = I2C_M_NOSTOP;
375: 
376:   /* 消息 2: 读操作，从设备读取一个字节的数据 */
377:   (work.msgv[1]).frequency=400000;
378:   (work.msgv[1]).length = 1;
379:   (work.msgv[1]).flags = I2C_M_READ;
380:   (work.msgv[1]).addr = slave_address;
381:   (work.msgv[1]).buffer = &val;
382: 
383:   /* 3. 执行 ioctl 调用，发起传输 */
384:   ret = ioctl(fd, I2CIOC_TRANSFER, &work);
385:   if (ret < 0)
386:   {
387:      printf("i2c: ioctl(I2CIOC_TRANSFER) failed: %d\n",fd);
388:      free( work.msgv);
389:      close(fd);
390:      return -1;
391:   }
392: 
393:   printf("reg:0x%02X val:%02x\n", reg_address, val);
394:   free( work.msgv);
395:   close(fd);
396: 
397:   return 0;
398: }
399: ```
400: 
401: </details>
402: 
403: ## 四、验证与测试
404: 
405: - 请参考 [I2C 驱动的验证与调试](./i2c_verification_guide.md)来测试您的驱动。

(End of file - total 405 lines)

221:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
222: 
223:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,
224:            CMU_CLK_UART0);

233:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
234:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
235:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
236:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
237:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,

242: /****************************************************************************
243:  * PSRAM 驱动 (LUT-based XSPI 控制器)
244:  * 来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h + hal_xspi.c + xspi_psram.c
245:  ****************************************************************************/
246: 
247: static uint32_t d13x_psram_read_efuse(uint32_t reg_addr)
248: {
249:   putreg32(0x1100, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
250:   uint32_t val = getreg32(reg_addr);
251:   putreg32(0x0, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
252:   return val;
253: }
254: 
255: static uint32_t d13x_psram_get_size(void)
256: {
257:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);
258:   uint8_t mark_id = fuse_218 & 0xFF;
259: 
260:   switch (mark_id)
261:     {
262:       case 0x00: return 0;
263:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
264:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
265:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
266:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
267:       case 0x06: case 0x07:
268:         return 16 * 1024 * 1024;
269:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
270:     }
271: }
272: 
273: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 (同步 CPU 模式)
274:  * LUT 编码: 每个条目 32 位, 包含两阶段 (ins_h/io_h/op_h + ins_l/io_l/op_l)
275:  */
276: 
277: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
278:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
279:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
280: {
281:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
282:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));
283: }
284: 
285: static void d13x_xspi_lut_update(void)
286: {
287:   putreg32(1, XSPI_LUT_UP);
288: }
289: 
290: static void __attribute__((unused)) d13x_xspi_lut_lock(int lock)
291: {
292:   putreg32(lock ? LUT_LOCK : LUT_UNLOCK, XSPI_LCKCR);
293: }
294: 
295: static void d13x_xspi_trigger(int lut_id)
296: {
297:   xspi_wait_idle();
298:   putreg32(lut_id, XSPI_START);
299:   xspi_wait_idle();
300: }
301: 
302: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 */
303: 
304: static void d13x_psram_write_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t mr_val)
305: {
306:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
307:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
308:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
309:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
310:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
311:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
312:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
313: 
314:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
315: 
316:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
317: 
318:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
319: 
320:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);
321: 
322:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */
323: 
324:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
325: }
326: 
327: static void d13x_psram_read_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t *mr_val)
328: {
329:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0x40 (READ_MR) on 1-line */
330:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0x40, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
331:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
332:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
333:   /* LUT[2]: READ 1-byte on 1-line */
334:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_READ, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
335:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
336: 
337:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
338:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
339: 
340:   *mr_val = (uint8_t)getreg32(XSPI_RDR);
341: }
342: 
343: static void d13x_psram_device_reset(void)
344: {
345:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xFF (RESET) on 1-line */
346: 
347:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xFF, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
348:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
349:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
350: }
351: 
352: static void d13x_psram_device_init(void)
353: {
354:   uint8_t mr4;
355: 
356:   /* 读取 MR4 检查当前配置 */
357: 
358:   d13x_psram_read_mr(0x04, &mr4);
359: 
360:   /* 配置 MR0: Burst Length = 32, Latency = 3 */
361: 
362:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x00, 0x19);
363: 
364:   /* 配置 MR4: 使能 XIP */
365: 
366:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x04, 0x80);
367: }
368: 
369: static void d13x_psram_xip_enable(void)
370: {
371:   uint32_t ctl;
372: 
373:   /* 配置 XIP LUT (OPI 模式下的 XIP 读/写序列)
374:    * LUT[16]: XIP READ (OPI 8-line, DDR)
375:    * LUT[0]:  XIP WRITE (OPI 8-line, DDR)
376:    * 这里使用简化配置: 启用 XIP 位, 由硬件处理 LUT 路由
377:    */
378: 
379:   /* 使能 XIP (CTL bit2) */
380: 
381:   xspi_wait_idle();
382:   ctl = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
383:   ctl |= CTL_XIP_EN;
384:   putreg32(ctl, XSPI_CTL);
385: }
386: 
387: static uint32_t d13x_psram_verify(void)
388: {
389:   volatile uint32_t *psram = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_PSRAM_BASE;
390:   uint32_t psram_size = d13x_psram_get_size();
391: 
392:   if (psram_size == 0)
393:     return 0;
394: 
395:   psram[0] = 0x12345678;
396:   psram[1] = 0x9ABCDEF0;
397: 
398:   if (psram[0] != 0x12345678)
399:     return 0;
400:   if (psram[1] != 0x9ABCDEF0)
401:     return 0;
402: 
403:   psram[0] = 0;
404:   psram[1] = 0;
405:   return psram_size;
406: }
407: 
408: static void d13x_psram_init(void)
409: {
410:   uint32_t reg;
411: 
412:   /* 首先验证 PSRAM 是否已由 bootloader 初始化 */
413: 
414:   if (d13x_psram_verify() > 0)
415:     return;
416: 
417:   /* 1. 使能 XSPI 时钟 (CMU_BASE + 0x45C) */
418: 
419:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
420:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
421:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
422: 
423:   /* 2. 复位 XSPI 控制器 (写 0 到 CTL) */
424: 
425:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CTL);
426: 
427:   /* 3. 配置 XSPI 控制器 (来源: luban-lite hal_xspi_init) */
428: 
429:   /* 时钟分频: div=0 → 最高频率 */
430: 
431:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CLK);
432: 
433:   /* TCR: 写保持=8, 读保持=2 */
434: 
435:   xspi_wait_idle();
436:   putreg32((8 << 16) | (2 << 20), XSPI_TCR);
437: 
438:   /* XSPI 模式 = OPI (bits[5:4] = 2) */
439: 
440:   xspi_wait_idle();
441:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
442:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
443:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
444: 
445:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
446: 
447:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
448:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
449:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
450: 
451:   /* Boundary = 1K */
452: 
453:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
454:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
455:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
456: 
457:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
458: 
459:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
460:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
461:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
462:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
463:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
464:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
465:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
466:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);
467: 
468:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
469: 
470:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
471: 
472:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
473:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
474:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
475: 
476:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
477: 
478:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
479:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
480:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
481: 
482:   /* CS1 DLL: 同上 */
483: 
484:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
485:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);
486:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
487:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);
488:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
489:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
490: 
491:   /* 4. 使能 XSPI 模块 */
492: 
493:   xspi_wait_idle();
494:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
495:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;
496:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
497: 
498:   /* 5. 复位 PSRAM 设备 */
499: 
500:   d13x_psram_device_reset();
501: 
502:   /* 6. 配置 PSRAM 模式寄存器 */
503: 
504:   d13x_psram_device_init();
505: 
506:   /* 7. 使能 XIP 模式 */
507: 
508:   d13x_psram_xip_enable();
509: 
510:   /* 8. 验证 */
511: 
512:   d13x_psram_verify();
513: }

5. **No `CONFIG_I2C=y` / `CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y` in standard Kconfig**: The I2C subsystem configuration uses custom `D13X_I2C` prefix rather than the standard NuttX `CONFIG_I2C` symbols required by the I2C master guide.

11: ### 驱动层 (Driver)
12: 
13: 负责实现芯片相关的 I2C 底层硬件操作。此层需要封装硬件细节，并向上层提供一个标准化的 `i2c_master_s` 句柄。

30: };

36:

42:

47: i2c_bus = bl602_i2cbus_initialize(0);
48: 
49: /* 将总线注册为 /dev/i2c0 */
50: i2c_register(i2c_bus, 0);

54:

63: ## 二、适配南向接口 (Lower Half)
64: 
65: 南向接口适配的核心任务是实现芯片的底层驱动，并提供一个标准的初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`，其中 `xxx` 代表芯片（Chip）名称。
66: 
67: ### 1、Kconfig 配置选项
68: 
69: 请在 Kconfig 中启用以下配置项以支持 I2C Master 驱动：
70: 
71: ```Makefile
72: CONFIG_I2C=y          # 必需，启用 I2C 子系统
73: CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y   # 必需，启用 I2C 字符设备驱动上层
74: CONFIG_I2C_RESET=y    # 可选，如果需要支持总线复位功能
75: ```
76: 
77: ### 2、核心数据结构
78: 
79: openvela I2C Master 驱动围绕 `struct i2c_master_s` 和 `struct i2c_ops_s` 这两个核心结构进行抽象。
80: 
81: ```C
82: /*
83:  * I2C Master 操作函数集。
84:  * 驱动开发者需要实现其中的函数指针，特别是 transfer 函数。
85:  */
86: struct i2c_ops_s
87: {
88:   /* 核心传输函数，必需 */
89:   CODE int (*transfer)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev,
90:                        FAR struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count);
91: #ifdef CONFIG_I2C_RESET
92:   /* 可选的总线复位函数 */
93:   CODE int (*reset)(FAR struct i2c_master_s *dev);
94: #endif
95: };
96: 
97: /*
98:  * I2C Master 设备句柄。
99:  * 这是南向驱动向上层提供的标准接口。
100:  * 开发者通常会定义一个包含此结构的私有设备结构体。
101:  */
102: struct i2c_master_s
103: {
104:   FAR const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* 指向操作函数集的指针 */
105: };
106: ```

109: 
110: 您需要根据下表的要求，在芯片驱动文件（`xxx_i2c.c`）中实现 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()` 函数。
111: 
112: | **项目**     | **描述**                                                                                                                                                             |
113: | :----------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
114: | **函数原型** | `struct i2c_master_s *xxx_i2cbus_initialize(int port)`                                                                                                               |

122: 
123: 本节通过代码示例，展示如何分步完成 I2C Master 驱动的适配。

127: #### 步骤一：定义私有设备结构体
128: 
129: 我们强烈建议您定义一个私有结构体，用于封装 I2C 控制器的所有状态信息，例如配置、锁、信号量以及运行时数据等。以下是 `bl602` 芯片的私有结构体示例：
130: 
131: > **核心要点：结构体成员布局** 为确保类型安全转换，私有结构体的**第一个成员**必须是 `const struct i2c_ops_s *ops;`。这使得框架可以将您的私有结构体指针安全地转换为标准的 `struct i2c_master_s *` 句柄。
132: 
133: <details>
134: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
135: 
136: ```C
137: /* 位于: arch/risc-v/src/bl602/bl602_i2c.c */
138: 
139: /* bl602 I2C 驱动的私有数据结构 */
140: struct bl602_i2c_priv_s
141: {
142:   /* 必须作为第一个成员，以兼容 i2c_master_s 类型转换 */
143:   const struct i2c_ops_s *ops; /* Standard I2C operations */
144: 
145:   /* 端口配置 */
146:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
147: 
148:   /* 状态与同步机制 */
149:   uint8_t  subflag;   /* Sub address flag */
150:   uint32_t subaddr;   /* Sub address */
151:   uint8_t  sublen;    /* Sub address length */
152:   mutex_t  lock;      /* Mutual exclusion mutex */
153:   sem_t    sem_isr;   /* Interrupt wait semaphore */
154: 
155:   /* 运行时数据 */
156:   /* I2C work state */
157:   uint8_t i2cstate;
158: 
159:   struct i2c_msg_s *msgv; /* Message list */
160: 
161:   uint8_t msgid; /* Current message ID */
162:   ssize_t bytes; /* Processed data bytes */
163:   int     refs;  /* Reference count */
164: };
165: ```
166: 
167: </details>
168: 
169: #### 步骤二：实现初始化函数 `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()`
170: 
171: 此函数负责完成硬件初始化，并返回一个配置好的 I2C Master 句柄。

173: <details>
174: <summary>点击展开代码</summary>
175: 
176: ```C
177: struct i2c_master_s *bl602_i2cbus_initialize(int port)
178: {
179:   struct bl602_i2c_priv_s         *priv;
180:   const struct bl602_i2c_config_s *config;
181: 
182:   /* 1. 根据 port 号获取对应的私有设备实例 */
183:   switch (port)
184:     {
185: #ifdef CONFIG_BL602_I2C0
186:     case 0:
187:       priv = (struct bl602_i2c_priv_s *)&bl602_i2c0_priv;
188:       break;
189: #endif
190:     default:
191:       return NULL;
192:     }
193: 
194:   config = priv->config;
195: /*************************************************
196: 此部分是把IIC配置为中断，不配置中断可以把此部分替换成IIC GPIO以及时钟初始化
197:   
198:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
199:   if (++priv->refs > 1)
200:   {
201:     nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);

203:   }
204: 
205:   bl602_configgpio(BOARD_I2C_SCL);

234:   /* 初始化 I2C 总线 0 */
