195: 
196:   dsi_write(DSI_PHY_RD_TIME, 50);
197:   dsi_write(DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME, (20 << 16) | 20);  /* HS2LP=20, LP2HS=20 */
198:   dsi_write(DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME, (20 << 16) | 20);
199: 
200:   /* 模拟配置 */
201: 
202:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_ANA_CFG2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_BIAS);
203:   up_udelay(5);
204: 
205:   val = dsi_read(DSI_ANA_CFG2);
206:   val &= ~DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP_MASK;
207:   val |= DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP(3);
208:   val &= ~DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO_MASK;
209:   val |= DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO(0x1F);
210:   dsi_write(DSI_ANA_CFG2, val);
211:   up_udelay(10);
212: 
213:   /* 校准 */
214: 
215:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_ANA_CFG2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_RESCAL);
216:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_ANA_CFG2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_ON_RESCAL);
217: 
218:   /* 等待校准完成 */
219: 
220:   uint32_t timeout = DSI_TIMEOUT_US;
221:   while (!(dsi_read(DSI_ANA_CFG2) & DSI_ANA_CFG2_RCAL_FLAG))
222:     {
223:       if (--timeout == 0)
224:         {
225:           ierr("DSI: Timeout waiting for RCAL flag\n");
226:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
227:         }
228:       up_udelay(1);
229:     }
230: 
231:   /* 使能时钟 */
232: 
233:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_ANA_CFG2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_CLK);
234: 
235:   /* PHY 复位序列 */
236: 
237:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_TEST1, BIT(0));  /* CLR */
238:   up_udelay(5);
239: 
240:   dsi_clr_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_RSTN);
241:   up_udelay(5);
242: 
243:   dsi_clr_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_SHUTDOWNZ);
244:   up_udelay(5);
245: 
246:   dsi_clr_bits(DSI_PHY_TEST1, BIT(0));  /* Clear CLR */
247:   up_udelay(5);
248: 
249:   /* 配置 HS 频率 */
250: 
251:   /* 简化: 使用默认 HS 频率配置 */
252: 
253:   /* 启动 PHY */
254: 
255:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_SHUTDOWNZ);
256:   up_udelay(5);
257: 
258:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_RSTN);
259:   up_udelay(5);
260: 
261:   /* 配置 LP11时间和数据通道 */
262: 
263:   val = dsi_read(DSI_PHY_CFG);
264:   val &= ~DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME_MASK;
265:   val |= DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME(10);
266:   val &= ~DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE_MASK;
267:   val |= DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE(DSI_LANE_NUM - 1);
268:   dsi_write(DSI_PHY_CFG, val);
269:   up_udelay(5);
270: 
271:   /* 使能时钟 */
272: 
273:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_CLK_EN);
274: 
275:   iinfo("DSI PHY initialized\n");
276:   return OK;
277: }
278: 
279: /****************************************************************************
280:  * Name: d13x_dsi_hs_clk_enable
281:  *
282:  * Description:
283:  *   使能/禁用 DSI 高速时钟
284:  *
285:  ****************************************************************************/
286: 
287: int d13x_dsi_hs_clk_enable(bool enable)
288: {
289:   int ret;
290: 
291:   if (enable)
292:     {
293:       ret = dsi_wait_stop_state_c();
294:       if (ret < 0)
295:         {
296:           return ret;
297:         }
298: 
299:       dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_HSCLK_REQ);
300:     }
301:   else
302:     {
303:       dsi_clr_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_HSCLK_REQ);
304:     }
305: 
306:   return OK;
307: }
308: 
309: /****************************************************************************
310:  * Name: d13x_dsi_init
311:  *
312:  * Description:
313:  *   初始化 MIPI DSI 控制器
314:  *
315:  ****************************************************************************/
316: 
317: int d13x_dsi_init(uint32_t pixel_clock)
318: {
319:   int ret;
320: 
321:   iinfo("Initializing MIPI DSI...\n");
322: 
323:   /* 使能控制器 */
324: 
325:   d13x_dsi_enable();
326: 
327:   /* 配置时钟分频
328:    * 根据 luban-lite drv_dsi.c aic_dsi_attach_panel():
329:    * sclk_rate = pixel_clock * format_div / lane_num
330:    * RGB888 format_div = 24, lane_num = 4
331:    * sclk_rate = 51200000 * 24 / 4 = 307200000 (307.2MHz)
332:    * LP 分频器 = sclk_rate / 8 / LP_RATE
333:    */
334: 
335:   uint32_t format_div = 24;  /* RGB888 */
336:   uint32_t lane_num = 4;
337:   uint32_t sclk_rate = pixel_clock * format_div / lane_num;
338:   uint32_t div = sclk_rate / 8 / DSI_LP_RATE;
339:   uint32_t val = dsi_read(DSI_CLK_CFG);
340:   val &= ~(DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV_MASK);
341:   val |= DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV(div);
342:   dsi_write(DSI_CLK_CFG, val);
343: 
344:   iinfo("DSI clock: pixel=%dHz, sclk=%dHz, div=%d\n",
345:         pixel_clock, sclk_rate, div);
346: 
347:   /* 配置包 */
348: 
349:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_CRC_RX_EN | DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_ECC_RX_EN);
350: 
351:   /* 配置 LP 传输时间 */
352: 
353:   dsi_write(DSI_DPI_LPTX_TIME, (64 << 16) | 64);
354: 
355:   /* 配置超时 */
356: 
357:   dsi_write(DSI_TO_CNT_CFG, 0);
358: 
359:   /* 配置命令模式 */
360: 
361:   val = BIT(24) | BIT(19) | BIT(18) | BIT(17) | BIT(16) |
362:         BIT(14) | BIT(13) | BIT(12) | BIT(11) | BIT(10) | BIT(9) | BIT(8);
363:   dsi_write(DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG, val);
364: 
365:   /* 配置通道 */
366: 
367:   dsi_write(DSI_LANE_CFG, 0x3210);
368: 
369:   /* 初始化 PHY */
370: 
371:   ret = d13x_dsi_phy_init(pixel_clock);
372:   if (ret < 0)
373:     {
374:       ierr("DSI PHY init failed: %d\n", ret);
375:       return ret;
376:     }
377: 
378:   /* 使能高速时钟 */
379: 
380:   ret = d13x_dsi_hs_clk_enable(true);
381:   if (ret < 0)
382:     {
383:       ierr("DSI HS clock enable failed: %d\n", ret);
384:       return ret;
385:     }
386: 
387:   iinfo("MIPI DSI initialized, pixel clock=%d Hz\n", pixel_clock);
388:   return OK;
389: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_de.c
3:  *
4:  * D13x 显示引擎 (Display Engine) 驱动 (简化版)
5:  * 寄存器来源: luban-lite aic_hal_de.h
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
15: #include <debug.h>
16: #include "chip.h"
17: 
18: /* 位操作宏 */
19: 
20: #ifndef BIT
21: #define BIT(nr)         (1UL << (nr))
22: #endif
23: 
24: /****************************************************************************
25:  * Pre-processor Definitions
26:  ****************************************************************************/
27: 
28: /* 全局控制 */
29: 
30: #define G_BASE                  0x000
31: #define DE_CTRL                 (G_BASE + 0x000)
32: #define DE_CONFIG_UPDATE        (G_BASE + 0x008)
33: 
34: /* UI 图层控制 */
35: 
36: #define UI_BASE                 0x0a0
37: #define UI_LAYER_CTRL           (UI_BASE + 0x000)
38: #define UI_LAYER_SIZE           (UI_BASE + 0x004)
39: #define UI_RECT_INPUT_SIZE(n)   (UI_BASE + 0x020 + 0x10 * (n))
40: #define UI_RECT_OFFSET(n)       (UI_BASE + 0x024 + 0x10 * (n))
41: #define UI_RECT_STRIDE(n)       (UI_BASE + 0x028 + 0x10 * (n))
42: #define UI_RECT_ADDR(n)         (UI_BASE + 0x02c + 0x10 * (n))
43: 
44: /* 混合控制 */
45: 
46: #define BLENDING_BASE           0x100
47: #define BLENDING_BG_COLOR       (BLENDING_BASE + 0x000)
48: #define BLENDING_OUTPUT_SIZE    (BLENDING_BASE + 0x004)
49: 
50: /* 时序控制 */
51: 
52: #define TIMING_BASE             0x1d0
53: #define TIMING_CTRL             (TIMING_BASE + 0x000)
54: #define TIMING_INIT             (TIMING_BASE + 0x004)
55: #define TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE      (TIMING_BASE + 0x010)
56: #define TIMING_H_PORCH          (TIMING_BASE + 0x014)
57: #define TIMING_V_PORCH          (TIMING_BASE + 0x018)
58: #define TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE       (TIMING_BASE + 0x01c)
59: 
60: /* 控制位域 */
61: 
62: #define DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN     BIT(0)
63: #define UI_LAYER_CTRL_EN        BIT(0)
64: #define TIMING_CTRL_EN          BIT(0)
65: 
66: /****************************************************************************
67:  * Private Functions
68:  ****************************************************************************/
69: 
70: static inline void de_write(uint32_t offset, uint32_t value)
71: {
72:   putreg32(value, D13X_DE_BASE + offset);
73: }
74: 
75: static inline uint32_t de_read(uint32_t offset)
76: {
77:   return getreg32(D13X_DE_BASE + offset);
78: }
79: 
80: /****************************************************************************
81:  * Public Functions
82:  ****************************************************************************/
83: 
84: /****************************************************************************
85:  * Name: d13x_de_init
86:  *
87:  * Description:
88:  *   初始化显示引擎
89:  *
90:  ****************************************************************************/
91: 
92: int d13x_de_init(uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
93: {
94:   iinfo("Initializing Display Engine: %dx%d\n", width, height);
95: 
96:   /* 配置更新使能 */
97: 
98:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
99: 
100:   /* 配置混合输出大小 */
101: 
102:   de_write(BLENDING_OUTPUT_SIZE, (height << 16) | width);
103:   de_write(BLENDING_BG_COLOR, 0x000000);  /* 黑色背景 */
104: 
105:   /* 配置 UI 图层 0 */
106: 
107:   de_write(UI_LAYER_SIZE, (height << 16) | width);
108: 
109:   /* 配置矩形区域 0 */
110: 
111:   de_write(UI_RECT_INPUT_SIZE(0), (height << 16) | width);
112:   de_write(UI_RECT_OFFSET(0), 0);
113:   de_write(UI_RECT_STRIDE(0), width * 4);  /* RGB888: 4 bytes/pixel */
114: 
115:   /* 使能 UI 图层 */
116: 
117:   de_write(UI_LAYER_CTRL, UI_LAYER_CTRL_EN);
118: 
119:   /* 配置时序 */
120: 
121:   /* 主动区域 */
122: 
123:   de_write(TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE, (height << 16) | width);
124: 
125:   /* 前后肩 (简化配置) */
126: 
127:   de_write(TIMING_H_PORCH, (160 << 16) | 160);  /* HBP=160, HFP=160 */
128:   de_write(TIMING_V_PORCH, (20 << 16) | 10);    /* VBP=20, VFP=10 */
129:   de_write(TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE, (8 << 16) | 40);  /* VSW=8, HSW=40 */
130: 
131:   /* 使能时序 */
132: 
133:   de_write(TIMING_CTRL, TIMING_CTRL_EN);
134: 
135:   /* 触发配置更新 */
136: 
137:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
138: 
139:   iinfo("Display Engine initialized\n");
140:   return OK;
141: }
142: 
143: /****************************************************************************
144:  * Name: d13x_de_set_framebuffer
145:  *
146:  * Description:
147:  *   设置帧缓冲地址
148:  *
149:  ****************************************************************************/
150: 
151: void d13x_de_set_framebuffer(uint32_t addr)
152: {
153:   /* 设置矩形区域 0 的帧缓冲地址 */
154: 
155:   de_write(UI_RECT_ADDR(0), addr);
156: 
157:   /* 触发配置更新 */
158: 
159:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
160: 
161:   iinfo("DE framebuffer set to 0x%08x\n", addr);
162: }
163: 
164: /****************************************************************************
165:  * Name: d13x_de_enable
166:  *
167:  * Description:
168:  *   使能显示引擎
169:  *
170:  ****************************************************************************/
171: 
172: void d13x_de_enable(void)
173: {
174:   /* 使能时序 */
175: 
176:   de_write(TIMING_CTRL, TIMING_CTRL_EN);
177: 
178:   /* 触发配置更新 */
179: 
180:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
181: 
182:   iinfo("Display Engine enabled\n");
183: }
184: 
185: /****************************************************************************
186:  * Name: d13x_de_disable
187:  *
188:  * Description:
189:  *   禁用显示引擎
190:  *
191:  ****************************************************************************/
192: 
193: void d13x_de_disable(void)
194: {
195:   /* 禁用时序 */
196: 
197:   de_write(TIMING_CTRL, 0);
198: 
199:   /* 触发配置更新 */
200: 
201:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
202: 
203:   iinfo("Display Engine disabled\n");
204: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_i2c.c
3:  *
4:  * D13x DesignWare I2C Master Driver (NuttX)
5:  * 寄存器来源: luban-lite hal_i2c.h + D13x User Manual §10
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
15: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
16: #include <nuttx/mutex.h>
17: #include <nuttx/i2c/i2c_master.h>
18: #include <debug.h>
19: #include "chip.h"
20: 
21: /****************************************************************************
22:  * Pre-processor Definitions
23:  ****************************************************************************/
24: 
25: /* DesignWare I2C 寄存器偏移 (来源: luban-lite hal_i2c.h) */
26: 
27: #define DW_I2C_CTL               0x00
28: #define DW_I2C_TAR               0x04
29: #define DW_I2C_SAR               0x08
30: #define DW_I2C_DATA_CMD          0x10
31: #define DW_I2C_SS_SCL_HCNT       0x20
32: #define DW_I2C_SS_SCL_LCNT       0x24
33: #define DW_I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT       0x28
34: #define DW_I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT       0x2C
35: #define DW_I2C_SDA_HOLD          0x30
36: #define DW_I2C_INTR_MASK         0x38
37: #define DW_I2C_INTR_CLR          0x3C
38: #define DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT     0x40
39: #define DW_I2C_ENABLE            0x48
40: #define DW_I2C_ENABLE_STATUS     0x4C
41: #define DW_I2C_STATUS            0x50
42: #define DW_I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE    0x54
43: #define DW_I2C_TXFLR             0x98
44: #define DW_I2C_RXFLR             0x9C
45: 
46: /* CTL 位域 */
47: 
48: #define DW_I2C_CTL_MASTER        (0x0 << 0)
49: #define DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_SS      (0x1 << 4)
50: #define DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS      (0x2 << 4)
51: #define DW_I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN    (1 << 6)
52: 
53: /* DATA_CMD 位域 */
54: 
55: #define DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_READ     (1 << 8)
56: #define DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP     (1 << 9)
57: #define DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_RESTART  (1 << 10)
58: 
59: /* INTR 位域 */
60: 
61: #define DW_I2C_INTR_TX_EMPTY     (1 << 4)
62: #define DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT      (1 << 6)
63: #define DW_I2C_INTR_RX_FULL      (1 << 2)
64: #define DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET     (1 << 9)
65: 
66: /* ENABLE 位域 */
67: 
68: #define DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT        (1 << 0)
69: 
70: /* STATUS 位域 */
71: 
72: #define DW_I2C_STATUS_ACTIVITY   (1 << 0)
73: 
74: /* FIFO 深度 */
75: 
76: #define DW_I2C_FIFO_DEPTH        8
77: 
78: /* 超时 (微秒) */
79: 
80: #define DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US        100000
81: 
82: /****************************************************************************
83:  * Private Types
84:  ****************************************************************************/
85: 
86: struct d13x_i2c_priv_s
87: {
88:   struct i2c_master_s  dev;     /* NuttX I2C master 接口 */
89:   uint32_t             base;    /* I2C 控制器基地址 */
90:   uint8_t              irq;     /* 中断号 */
91:   mutex_t              lock;    /* 互斥锁 */
92: };
93: 
94: /****************************************************************************
95:  * Private Data
96:  ****************************************************************************/
97: 
98: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(struct i2c_master_s *dev,
99:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count);
100: static int d13x_i2c_setup(struct i2c_master_s *dev);
101: static int d13x_i2c_shutdown(struct i2c_master_s *dev);
102: 
103: static const struct i2c_ops_s g_d13x_i2c_ops =
104: {
105:   .transfer = d13x_i2c_transfer,
106:   .setup = d13x_i2c_setup,
107:   .shutdown = d13x_i2c_shutdown,
108: };
109: 
110: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
111: static struct d13x_i2c_priv_s g_i2c0_priv =
112: {
113:   .dev =
114:   {
115:     .ops = &g_d13x_i2c_ops,
116:   },
117:   .base = D13X_I2C0_BASE,
118:   .irq  = 84,
119: };
120: #endif
121: 
122: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
123: static struct d13x_i2c_priv_s g_i2c1_priv =
124: {
125:   .dev =
126:   {
127:     .ops = &g_d13x_i2c_ops,
128:   },
129:   .base = D13X_I2C1_BASE,
130:   .irq  = 85,
131: };
132: #endif
133: 
134: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
135: static struct d13x_i2c_priv_s g_i2c2_priv =
136: {
137:   .dev =
138:   {
139:     .ops = &g_d13x_i2c_ops,
140:   },
141:   .base = D13X_I2C2_BASE,
142:   .irq  = 86,
143: };
144: #endif
145: 
146: /****************************************************************************
147:  * Private Functions
148:  ****************************************************************************/
149: 
150: static inline void dw_i2c_write(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
151:                                 uint32_t offset, uint32_t value)
152: {
153:   putreg32(value, priv->base + offset);
154: }
155: 
156: static inline uint32_t dw_i2c_read(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
157:                                    uint32_t offset)
158: {
159:   return getreg32(priv->base + offset);
160: }
161: 
162: static void dw_i2c_enable(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
163: {
164:   uint32_t reg = dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE);
165:   reg |= DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
166:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE, reg);
167: }
168: 
169: static void dw_i2c_disable(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
170: {
171:   uint32_t reg = dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE);
172:   reg &= ~DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
173:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE, reg);
174: }
175: 
176: static int dw_i2c_wait_bus_idle(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
177: {
178:   uint32_t timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
179: 
180:   while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_STATUS) & DW_I2C_STATUS_ACTIVITY)
181:     {
182:       if (--timeout == 0)
183:         {
184:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
185:         }
186: 
187:       up_udelay(1);
188:     }
189: 
190:   return OK;
191: }
192: 
193: static int dw_i2c_send_addr(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
194:                             uint16_t addr, bool restart)
195: {
196:   uint32_t cmd = addr & 0x7FF;
197: 
198:   if (restart)
199:     {
200:       cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_RESTART;
201:     }
202: 
203:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
204:   return OK;
205: }
206: 
207: static int dw_i2c_xfer_write(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
208:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
209: {
210:   uint32_t timeout;
211:   int i;
212: 
213:   /* 设置目标地址 */
214: 
215:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
216: 
217:   /* 发送写命令 */
218: 
219:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
220:     {
221:       uint32_t cmd = msg->buffer[i];
222: 
223:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
224:

## D13x Display Driver Code Review -- Post-Fix Verification

### Previously Reported Issues (fixes verified)

| # | Previously Reported Issue | Fix Status |
|---|--------------------------|------------|
| 1 | MIPI DSI LP clock divider was 0 | **FIXED** -- `sclk_rate = pixel_clock * 24 / 4` computed correctly; `div = sclk_rate / 8 / DSI_LP_RATE` = 3 (artinchip_dsi.c:335-342) |
| 2 | MIPI DSI HS clock never configured | **FIXED** -- `d13x_dsi_hs_clk_enable(true)` called at line 380, which sets `DSI_PHY_CFG_HSCLK_REQ` after verifying stop state C |
| 3 | I2C ops missing setup/shutdown | **FIXED** -- `d13x_i2c_setup` (line 400) and `d13x_i2c_shutdown` (line 422) implemented and assigned in `g_d13x_i2c_ops` (line 103-108) |
| 4 | DE hardware accessed after failed init | **FIXED** -- else-guard at artinchip_fb.c:217-224 prevents `set_framebuffer`/`enable` if `d13x_de_init` returns error |
| 5 | Panel init dead code (unused params) | **FIXED** -- `d13x_panel_init(void)` now takes zero parameters (artinchip_panel.c:115); no dead code present |
| 6 | Unused DE_BASE_OFFSET macro | **FIXED** -- macro does not exist anywhere in the codebase (confirmed via grep) |

### Review Checklist

| # | Item | Status | Issue |
|---|------|--------|-------|
| 1 | fb_vtable_s -- pandisplay still missing? | **FAIL** | `pandisplay` callback is not assigned in `fbi->vtable` (artinchip_fb.c:182-186). The driver allocates double buffers (`D13X_FB_BUFFER_COUNT=2`) and advertises `yres_virtual = 1200` (2x height), but provides no mechanism to flip to the second buffer. The `pandisplay` field exists in `struct fb_vtable_s` (fb.h:831) and is the standard NuttX interface for buffer flipping. Without it, the second buffer is allocated but unreachable from userspace. |
| 2 | MIPI DSI LP divider calculation now correct | **PASS** | `sclk_rate = 51200000 * 24 / 4 = 307,200,000`. `div = 307200000 / 8 / 10000000 = 3`. Resulting LP clock = `307200000 / 8 / 3 = 12,800,000 Hz` (12.8 MHz), which is reasonable above the 10 MHz target. Divider is non-zero and valid. |
| 3 | I2C setup/shutdown callbacks present | **PASS** | `d13x_i2c_setup` enables the controller; `d13x_i2c_shutdown` disables it. Both are assigned in `g_d13x_i2c_ops`. |
| 4 | DE init failure guard present | **PASS** | The `else` block at artinchip_fb.c:217 ensures DE framebuffer setup and enable only execute when `d13x_de_init` succeeds. |
| 5 | Panel dead code removed | **PASS** | `d13x_panel_init(void)` has no unused parameters. All helper functions (`panel_dsi_write_cmd`, `panel_send_dcs_cmd`) are actively called. No unreachable code paths. |
| 6 | Any remaining compilation warnings | **FAIL** | Two issues: (a) `uint32_t ret` declared at artinchip_dsi.c:192 in `d13x_dsi_phy_init` is **never used** -- the function has its own `return OK` and `return -ETIMEDOUT` statements that do not reference `ret`. This will produce an `-Wunused-variable` warning. (b) `uint32_t timeout` declared at artinchip_dsi.c:220 is a **declaration-after-statement** -- it follows executable statements (lines 196-217). NuttX commonly compiles with `-Wdeclaration-after-statement`, which will produce a warning here. |
| 7 | Any new issues introduced | **FAIL** | See details below. |

### New Issues Found

**A. Unused variable `ret` in `d13x_dsi_phy_init` (artinchip_dsi.c:192)**
The variable `ret` is declared but never assigned or referenced. The function returns `OK` or `-ETIMEDOUT` directly. This will cause a compiler warning (`-Wunused-variable`) and is dead code.

**B. Declaration-after-statement in `d13x_dsi_phy_init` (artinchip_dsi.c:220)**
`uint32_t timeout = DSI_TIMEOUT_US;` is declared after executable statements (PHY timing writes, analog config, calibration enable). NuttX kernel builds typically enable `-Wdeclaration-after-statement`, which will flag this.

**C. No error propagation from DSI/panel init in `up_fbinitialize` (artinchip_fb.c:196-208)**
When `d13x_dsi_init()` fails (line 197-199), the code logs the error but **continues** to call `d13x_panel_init()` (line 204), which attempts to write DSI commands to a non-functional DSI controller. The panel init will likely timeout or produce errors. The same applies if DSI succeeds but panel init fails -- DE init still proceeds. These should either return early or be gated with similar else-guards as the DE path.

**D. Double-buffer advertised but non-functional (artinchip_fb.c:96-99, 182-186)**
`pinfo->fblen` is set to `fb_size * 2` and `yres_virtual` to `1200`, but no `pandisplay` callback exists. The NuttX framebuffer framework will present 2 screens' worth of virtual space to userspace, but the buffer flip ioctl will fail silently (returns OK with no-op since the vtable slot is NULL/zeroed). This wastes memory and misleads userspace applications.

### Summary

All 6 previously reported issues have been **successfully fixed**. However, the review found:

- **2 compilation warning issues**: unused variable `ret` in DSI PHY init, and a declaration-after-statement in the same function.
- **1 functional gap**: `pandisplay` callback missing from fb_vtable_s despite double-buffer allocation, making the second buffer unusable.
- **1 robustness concern**: `up_fbinitialize` does not abort on DSI or panel init failure, leading to operations on non-functional hardware.

The recommended fixes are:
1. Remove the unused `ret` declaration from `d13x_dsi_phy_init`.
2. Move `uint32_t timeout` to the top of the function scope in `d13x_dsi_phy_init`.
3. Add a `pandisplay` callback that updates the DE framebuffer address (`d13x_de_set_framebuffer`) based on `pinfo->yoffset`, or simplify to single-buffer mode by removing the double-buffer allocation.
4. Add early-return or else-guard logic after `d13x_dsi_init` failure to prevent subsequent calls to panel and DE init on a broken DSI bus.

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_dsi.c
3:  *
4:  * D13x MIPI DSI 控制器驱动 (简化版)
5:  * 寄存器来源: luban-lite aic_hal_dsi.h
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
15: #include <debug.h>
16: #include "chip.h"
17: 
18: /* 位操作宏 */
19: 
20: #ifndef BIT
21: #define BIT(nr)         (1UL << (nr))
22: #endif
23: 
24: #ifndef GENMASK
25: #define GENMASK(h, l)   (((0xFFFFFFFFUL) << (l)) & (0xFFFFFFFFUL >> (31UL - (h))))
26: #endif
27: 
28: /****************************************************************************
29:  * Pre-processor Definitions
30:  ****************************************************************************/
31: 
32: /* MIPI DSI 寄存器偏移 (来源: luban-lite aic_hal_dsi.h) */
33: 
34: #define DSI_CTL                 0x00
35: #define DSI_CLK_CFG             0x04
36: #define DSI_DPI_IN_POL          0x10
37: #define DSI_DPI_IN_FMT          0x14
38: #define DSI_DPI_VC              0x18
39: #define DSI_DPI_LPTX_TIME       0x1C
40: #define DSI_VID_MODE_CFG        0x30
41: #define DSI_VID_PKG_SIZE        0x34
42: #define DSI_VID_HINACT_TIME     0x40
43: #define DSI_VID_HT_TIME         0x44
44: #define DSI_VID_VBLANK_LINE     0x48
45: #define DSI_VID_VACT_LINE       0x4C
46: #define DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG        0x50
47: #define DSI_TO_CNT_CFG          0x70
48: #define DSI_PHY_CFG             0x80
49: #define DSI_PHY_STA             0x84
50: #define DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME        0x88
51: #define DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME       0x8C
52: #define DSI_PHY_RD_TIME         0x90
53: #define DSI_PHY_TEST1           0xC0
54: #define DSI_PHY_TEST2           0xC4
55: #define DSI_DPI_IF_CFG          0x400
56: #define DSI_LANE_CFG            0x410
57: #define DSI_ANA_CFG1            0x500
58: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2            0x504
59: 
60: /* CTL 位域 */
61: 
62: #define DSI_CTL_EN              BIT(0)
63: #define DSI_CTL_DSI_MODE        BIT(1)
64: #define DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_CRC_RX_EN   BIT(7)
65: #define DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_ECC_RX_EN   BIT(6)
66: 
67: /* PHY_CFG 位域 */
68: 
69: #define DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_SHUTDOWNZ   BIT(4)
70: #define DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_RSTN        BIT(5)
71: #define DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_CLK_EN      BIT(6)
72: #define DSI_PHY_CFG_HSCLK_REQ       BIT(2)
73: #define DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME_MASK  GENMASK(15, 8)
74: #define DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME(x)    (((x) & 0xFF) << 8)
75: #define DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE_MASK  GENMASK(1, 0)
76: #define DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE(x)    (((x) & 0x3) << 0)
77: 
78: /* PHY_STA 位域 */
79: 
80: #define DSI_PHY_STA_STOP_STATE_C    BIT(2)
81: #define DSI_PHY_STA_PHY_LOCK        BIT(0)
82: 
83: /* ANA_CFG2 位域 */
84: 
85: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_BIAS        BIT(0)
86: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP_MASK     GENMASK(2, 1)
87: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP(x)       (((x) & 0x3) << 1)
88: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO_MASK    GENMASK(7, 3)
89: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO(x)      (((x) & 0x1F) << 3)
90: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_RESCAL      BIT(8)
91: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2_ON_RESCAL      BIT(9)
92: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2_RCAL_FLAG      BIT(10)
93: #define DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_CLK         BIT(12)
94: 
95: /* CLK_CFG 位域 */
96: 
97: #define DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV_MASK     GENMASK(7, 0)
98: #define DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV(x)       (((x) & 0xFF) << 0)
99: 
100: /* 默认配置 */
101: 
102: #define DSI_LP_RATE                 (10 * 1000 * 1000)  /* 10MHz */
103: #define DSI_LANE_NUM                4
104: #define DSI_TIMEOUT_US              1000000
105: 
106: /****************************************************************************
107:  * Private Functions
108:  ****************************************************************************/
109: 
110: static inline void dsi_write(uint32_t offset, uint32_t value)
111: {
112:   putreg32(value, D13X_MIPI_DSI_BASE + offset);
113: }
114: 
115: static inline uint32_t dsi_read(uint32_t offset)
116: {
117:   return getreg32(D13X_MIPI_DSI_BASE + offset);
118: }
119: 
120: static inline void dsi_set_bits(uint32_t offset, uint32_t bits)
121: {
122:   uint32_t val = dsi_read(offset);
123:   val |= bits;
124:   dsi_write(offset, val);
125: }
126: 
127: static inline void dsi_clr_bits(uint32_t offset, uint32_t bits)
128: {
129:   uint32_t val = dsi_read(offset);
130:   val &= ~bits;
131:   dsi_write(offset, val);
132: }
133: 
134: static int dsi_wait_stop_state_c(void)
135: {
136:   uint32_t timeout = DSI_TIMEOUT_US;
137: 
138:   while (!(dsi_read(DSI_PHY_STA) & DSI_PHY_STA_STOP_STATE_C))
139:     {
140:       if (--timeout == 0)
141:         {
142:           ierr("DSI: Timeout waiting for stop state C\n");
143:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
144:         }
145:       up_udelay(1);
146:     }
147: 
148:   return OK;
149: }
150: 
151: /****************************************************************************
152:  * Public Functions
153:  ****************************************************************************/
154: 
155: /****************************************************************************
156:  * Name: d13x_dsi_enable
157:  *
158:  * Description:
159:  *   使能 MIPI DSI 控制器
160:  *
161:  ****************************************************************************/
162: 
163: void d13x_dsi_enable(void)
164: {
165:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_EN);
166: }
167: 
168: /****************************************************************************
169:  * Name: d13x_dsi_disable
170:  *
171:  * Description:
172:  *   禁用 MIPI DSI 控制器
173:  *
174:  ****************************************************************************/
175: 
176: void d13x_dsi_disable(void)
177: {
178:   dsi_clr_bits(DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_EN);
179: }
180: 
181: /****************************************************************************
182:  * Name: d13x_dsi_phy_init
183:  *
184:  * Description:
185:  *   初始化 MIPI DSI PHY
186:  *
187:  ****************************************************************************/
188: 
189: int d13x_dsi_phy_init(uint32_t pixel_clock)
190: {
191:   uint32_t val;
192:   uint32_t timeout;
193: 
194:   /* PHY 时序配置 */
195: 
196:   dsi_write(DSI_PHY_RD_TIME, 50);
197:   dsi_write(DSI_PHY_CLK_TIME, (20 << 16) | 20);  /* HS2LP=20, LP2HS=20 */
198:   dsi_write(DSI_PHY_DATA_TIME, (20 << 16) | 20);
199: 
200:   /* 模拟配置 */
201: 
202:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_ANA_CFG2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_BIAS);
203:   up_udelay(5);
204: 
205:   val = dsi_read(DSI_ANA_CFG2);
206:   val &= ~DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP_MASK;
207:   val |= DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_VP(3);
208:   val &= ~DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO_MASK;
209:   val |= DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_LDO(0x1F);
210:   dsi_write(DSI_ANA_CFG2, val);
211:   up_udelay(10);
212: 
213:   /* 校准 */
214: 
215:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_ANA_CFG2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_RESCAL);
216:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_ANA_CFG2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_ON_RESCAL);
217: 
218:   /* 等待校准完成 */
219: 
220:   timeout = DSI_TIMEOUT_US;
221:   while (!(dsi_read(DSI_ANA_CFG2) & DSI_ANA_CFG2_RCAL_FLAG))
222:     {
223:       if (--timeout == 0)
224:         {
225:           ierr("DSI: Timeout waiting for RCAL flag\n");
226:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
227:         }
228:       up_udelay(1);
229:     }
230: 
231:   /* 使能时钟 */
232: 
233:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_ANA_CFG2, DSI_ANA_CFG2_EN_CLK);
234: 
235:   /* PHY 复位序列 */
236: 
237:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_TEST1, BIT(0));  /* CLR */
238:   up_udelay(5);
239: 
240:   dsi_clr_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_RSTN);
241:   up_udelay(5);
242: 
243:   dsi_clr_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_SHUTDOWNZ);
244:   up_udelay(5);
245: 
246:   dsi_clr_bits(DSI_PHY_TEST1, BIT(0));  /* Clear CLR */
247:   up_udelay(5);
248: 
249:   /* 配置 HS 频率 */
250: 
251:   /* 简化: 使用默认 HS 频率配置 */
252: 
253:   /* 启动 PHY */
254: 
255:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_SHUTDOWNZ);
256:   up_udelay(5);
257: 
258:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_RSTN);
259:   up_udelay(5);
260: 
261:   /* 配置 LP11时间和数据通道 */
262: 
263:   val = dsi_read(DSI_PHY_CFG);
264:   val &= ~DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME_MASK;
265:   val |= DSI_PHY_CFG_LP11_TIME(10);
266:   val &= ~DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE_MASK;
267:   val |= DSI_PHY_CFG_DATA_LANE(DSI_LANE_NUM - 1);
268:   dsi_write(DSI_PHY_CFG, val);
269:   up_udelay(5);
270: 
271:   /* 使能时钟 */
272: 
273:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_RST_CLK_EN);
274: 
275:   iinfo("DSI PHY initialized\n");
276:   return OK;
277: }
278: 
279: /****************************************************************************
280:  * Name: d13x_dsi_hs_clk_enable
281:  *
282:  * Description:
283:  *   使能/禁用 DSI 高速时钟
284:  *
285:  ****************************************************************************/
286: 
287: int d13x_dsi_hs_clk_enable(bool enable)
288: {
289:   int ret;
290: 
291:   if (enable)
292:     {
293:       ret = dsi_wait_stop_state_c();
294:       if (ret < 0)
295:         {
296:           return ret;
297:         }
298: 
299:       dsi_set_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_HSCLK_REQ);
300:     }
301:   else
302:     {
303:       dsi_clr_bits(DSI_PHY_CFG, DSI_PHY_CFG_HSCLK_REQ);
304:     }
305: 
306:   return OK;
307: }
308: 
309: /****************************************************************************
310:  * Name: d13x_dsi_init
311:  *
312:  * Description:
313:  *   初始化 MIPI DSI 控制器
314:  *
315:  ****************************************************************************/
316: 
317: int d13x_dsi_init(uint32_t pixel_clock)
318: {
319:   int ret;
320: 
321:   iinfo("Initializing MIPI DSI...\n");
322: 
323:   /* 使能控制器 */
324: 
325:   d13x_dsi_enable();
326: 
327:   /* 配置时钟分频
328:    * 根据 luban-lite drv_dsi.c aic_dsi_attach_panel():
329:    * sclk_rate = pixel_clock * format_div / lane_num
330:    * RGB888 format_div = 24, lane_num = 4
331:    * sclk_rate = 51200000 * 24 / 4 = 307200000 (307.2MHz)
332:    * LP 分频器 = sclk_rate / 8 / LP_RATE
333:    */
334: 
335:   uint32_t format_div = 24;  /* RGB888 */
336:   uint32_t lane_num = 4;
337:   uint32_t sclk_rate = pixel_clock * format_div / lane_num;
338:   uint32_t div = sclk_rate / 8 / DSI_LP_RATE;
339:   uint32_t val = dsi_read(DSI_CLK_CFG);
340:   val &= ~(DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV_MASK);
341:   val |= DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV(div);
342:   dsi_write(DSI_CLK_CFG, val);
343: 
344:   iinfo("DSI clock: pixel=%dHz, sclk=%dHz, div=%d\n",
345:         pixel_clock, sclk_rate, div);
346: 
347:   /* 配置包 */
348: 
349:   dsi_set_bits(DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_CRC_RX_EN | DSI_CTL_PKG_CFG_ECC_RX_EN);
350: 
351:   /* 配置 LP 传输时间 */
352: 
353:   dsi_write(DSI_DPI_LPTX_TIME, (64 << 16) | 64);
354: 
355:   /* 配置超时 */
356: 
357:   dsi_write(DSI_TO_CNT_CFG, 0);
358: 
359:   /* 配置命令模式 */
360: 
361:   val = BIT(24) | BIT(19) | BIT(18) | BIT(17) | BIT(16) |
362:         BIT(14) | BIT(13) | BIT(12) | BIT(11) | BIT(10) | BIT(9) | BIT(8);
363:   dsi_write(DSI_CMD_MODE_CFG, val);
364: 
365:   /* 配置通道 */
366: 
367:   dsi_write(DSI_LANE_CFG, 0x3210);
368: 
369:   /* 初始化 PHY */
370: 
371:   ret = d13x_dsi_phy_init(pixel_clock);
372:   if (ret < 0)
373:     {
374:       ierr("DSI PHY init failed: %d\n", ret);
375:       return ret;
376:     }
377: 
378:   /* 使能高速时钟 */
379: 
380:   ret = d13x_dsi_hs_clk_enable(true);
381:   if (ret < 0)
382:     {
383:       ierr("DSI HS clock enable failed: %d\n", ret);
384:       return ret;
385:     }
386: 
387:   iinfo("MIPI DSI initialized, pixel clock=%d Hz\n", pixel_clock);
388:   return OK;
389: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_de.c
3:  *
4:  * D13x 显示引擎 (Display Engine) 驱动 (简化版)
5:  * 寄存器来源: luban-lite aic_hal_de.h
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
15: #include <debug.h>
16: #include "chip.h"
17: 
18: /* 位操作宏 */
19: 
20: #ifndef BIT
21: #define BIT(nr)         (1UL << (nr))
22: #endif
23: 
24: /****************************************************************************
25:  * Pre-processor Definitions
26:  ****************************************************************************/
27: 
28: /* 全局控制 */
29: 
30: #define G_BASE                  0x000
31: #define DE_CTRL                 (G_BASE + 0x000)
32: #define DE_CONFIG_UPDATE        (G_BASE + 0x008)
33: 
34: /* UI 图层控制 */
35: 
36: #define UI_BASE                 0x0a0
37: #define UI_LAYER_CTRL           (UI_BASE + 0x000)
38: #define UI_LAYER_SIZE           (UI_BASE + 0x004)
39: #define UI_RECT_INPUT_SIZE(n)   (UI_BASE + 0x020 + 0x10 * (n))
40: #define UI_RECT_OFFSET(n)       (UI_BASE + 0x024 + 0x10 * (n))
41: #define UI_RECT_STRIDE(n)       (UI_BASE + 0x028 + 0x10 * (n))
42: #define UI_RECT_ADDR(n)         (UI_BASE + 0x02c + 0x10 * (n))
43: 
44: /* 混合控制 */
45: 
46: #define BLENDING_BASE           0x100
47: #define BLENDING_BG_COLOR       (BLENDING_BASE + 0x000)
48: #define BLENDING_OUTPUT_SIZE    (BLENDING_BASE + 0x004)
49: 
50: /* 时序控制 */
51: 
52: #define TIMING_BASE             0x1d0
53: #define TIMING_CTRL             (TIMING_BASE + 0x000)
54: #define TIMING_INIT             (TIMING_BASE + 0x004)
55: #define TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE      (TIMING_BASE + 0x010)
56: #define TIMING_H_PORCH          (TIMING_BASE + 0x014)
57: #define TIMING_V_PORCH          (TIMING_BASE + 0x018)
58: #define TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE       (TIMING_BASE + 0x01c)
59: 
60: /* 控制位域 */
61: 
62: #define DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN     BIT(0)
63: #define UI_LAYER_CTRL_EN        BIT(0)
64: #define TIMING_CTRL_EN          BIT(0)
65: 
66: /****************************************************************************
67:  * Private Functions
68:  ****************************************************************************/
69: 
70: static inline void de_write(uint32_t offset, uint32_t value)
71: {
72:   putreg32(value, D13X_DE_BASE + offset);
73: }
74: 
75: static inline uint32_t de_read(uint32_t offset)
76: {
77:   return getreg32(D13X_DE_BASE + offset);
78: }
79: 
80: /****************************************************************************
81:  * Public Functions
82:  ****************************************************************************/
83: 
84: /****************************************************************************
85:  * Name: d13x_de_init
86:  *
87:  * Description:
88:  *   初始化显示引擎
89:  *
90:  ****************************************************************************/
91: 
92: int d13x_de_init(uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
93: {
94:   iinfo("Initializing Display Engine: %dx%d\n", width, height);
95: 
96:   /* 配置更新使能 */
97: 
98:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
99: 
100:   /* 配置混合输出大小 */
101: 
102:   de_write(BLENDING_OUTPUT_SIZE, (height << 16) | width);
103:   de_write(BLENDING_BG_COLOR, 0x000000);  /* 黑色背景 */
104: 
105:   /* 配置 UI 图层 0 */
106: 
107:   de_write(UI_LAYER_SIZE, (height << 16) | width);
108: 
109:   /* 配置矩形区域 0 */
110: 
111:   de_write(UI_RECT_INPUT_SIZE(0), (height << 16) | width);
112:   de_write(UI_RECT_OFFSET(0), 0);
113:   de_write(UI_RECT_STRIDE(0), width * 4);  /* RGB888: 4 bytes/pixel */
114: 
115:   /* 使能 UI 图层 */
116: 
117:   de_write(UI_LAYER_CTRL, UI_LAYER_CTRL_EN);
118: 
119:   /* 配置时序 */
120: 
121:   /* 主动区域 */
122: 
123:   de_write(TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE, (height << 16) | width);
124: 
125:   /* 前后肩 (简化配置) */
126: 
127:   de_write(TIMING_H_PORCH, (160 << 16) | 160);  /* HBP=160, HFP=160 */
128:   de_write(TIMING_V_PORCH, (20 << 16) | 10);    /* VBP=20, VFP=10 */
129:   de_write(TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE, (8 << 16) | 40);  /* VSW=8, HSW=40 */
130: 
131:   /* 使能时序 */
132: 
133:   de_write(TIMING_CTRL, TIMING_CTRL_EN);
134: 
135:   /* 触发配置更新 */
136: 
137:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
138: 
139:   iinfo("Display Engine initialized\n");
140:   return OK;
141: }
142: 
143: /****************************************************************************
144:  * Name: d13x_de_set_framebuffer
145:  *
146:  * Description:
147:  *   设置帧缓冲地址
148:  *
149:  ****************************************************************************/
150: 
151: void d13x_de_set_framebuffer(uint32_t addr)
152: {
153:   /* 设置矩形区域 0 的帧缓冲地址 */
154: 
155:   de_write(UI_RECT_ADDR(0), addr);
156: 
157:   /* 触发配置更新 */
158: 
159:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
160: 
161:   iinfo("DE framebuffer set to 0x%08x\n", addr);
162: }
163: 
164: /****************************************************************************
165:  * Name: d13x_de_enable
166:  *
167:  * Description:

469: #endif

472:     }

474:   /* 使能 I2C 模块时钟 */
475: 
476:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
477:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
478:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
479: 
480:   /* 禁用 I2C 以配置 */
481: 
482:   dw_i2c_disable(priv);
483: 
484:   /* 配置为主模式, Fast Mode (400kHz), 重启使能 */
485:

487:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_CTL, reg);

489:   /* 配置 SCL 时序 (400kHz @ I2C模块时钟)
490:    * 根据 luban-lite HAL, I2C模块时钟为24MHz (I2C_DEFALT_CLOCK)
491:    * FS_SCL_HCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 8 = 22
492:    * FS_SCL_LCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 1 = 29
493:    */
494: 
495:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, 22);
496:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, 29);
497: 
498:   /* 设置 SDA 保持时间 */
499: 
500:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_SDA_HOLD, 12);
501: 
502:   /* 设置 TX/RX FIFO 阈值 */
503: 
504:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xFFFF);
505:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_MASK, 0);
506: 
507:   /* 使能 I2C */
508: 
509:   dw_i2c_enable(priv);
510: 
511:   /* 初始化互斥锁 */
512: 
513:   nxmutex_init(&priv->lock);
514: 
515:   iinfo("I2C%d 初始化完成, 基地址=0x%08X\n", bus, priv->base);
516: 
517:   return &priv->dev;
518: }
